meta.source: Prilog III. Opisne ocjene i grafički prilozi natječajnih rješenja — Arhitektonski natječaj za stadion Maksimir i SRC Svetice

entries.descriptionHr: Plavo-bijela perforirana ovojnica omata kompaktni volumen i postupno mijenja visinu od niže sjeverne prema višoj južnoj strani. Kontinuirana tribinska zdjela na donjoj razini nadopunjena je zasebnim gornjim prstenovima, dok široka konzolna nadstrešnica natkriva gledalište i otvara sjevernu stranu prema Maksimiru. U anketnom dijelu atletski stadion i dvorane spuštaju se u zeleni teren preko ozelenjenih krovova, a pješačko-biciklistički sustav nastavlja se prema čvorištu Borongaj.
entries.descriptionEn: A blue-and-white perforated envelope wraps the compact volume and gradually rises from the lower northern side toward the south. A continuous lower seating bowl is complemented by separate upper tiers, while a broad cantilevered canopy covers the stands and opens the northern edge toward Maksimir Park. In the survey area, the athletics stadium and sports halls merge into the landscape through planted roofs, while the pedestrian and cycling network continues southward toward the Borongaj transport hub.
roundNoteHr: U trećem krugu eliminirani su dobro razrađeni, ali generički projekti, prijedlozi hermetičnog odnosa prema javnom prostoru, projekti s nedovoljno razrađenim konstrukcijskim sustavom te financijski zahtjevna rješenja ili rješenja koja nisu dovoljno jasno izražavala primarni program.

Velik broj radova ponudio je dobro artikuliran, ali nedovoljno specifičan odnos prema lokaciji i njezinu nasljeđu. Posebno je zanimljiv bio projekt koji je zadržavao dijelove postojeće konstrukcije, no takav pristup nije bio izvediv zbog potrebe za njezinim uklanjanjem uslijed utvrđenih konstrukcijskih nedostataka.
roundNoteEn: In the third round, the jury eliminated projects that were well developed but generic, hermetic in their relationship with public space, insufficiently resolved in structural terms, financially demanding or unable to express the primary programme clearly.

A large proportion of the proposals offered a well-articulated but insufficiently specific response to the site and its legacy. A project that retained parts of the existing structure was considered particularly interesting, but this approach was not feasible because the structure had to be demolished due to identified structural deficiencies.

entries.descriptionHr: Produženi park prima stadion kao organski modeliran paviljon, postavljen na masivno podnožje i obavijen nizom betonskih arkada koje mu daju snažan, ritmiziran obod. Valoviti krov zaokružuje volumen, dok se sjeverna tribina izdvaja u dva uzdignuta kraka povezana s Maksimirskom širokim krajobraznim stubištem. U anketnom dijelu sportske građevine raspoređene su kao niski paviljoni uz sjever–jug os, s aktivnim krovovima i otvorenim javnim prostorima koji postupno vode prema Borongaju.
entries.descriptionEn: The extended park receives the stadium as an organically modelled pavilion, set on a solid plinth and wrapped by a sequence of concrete arcades that give it a strong rhythmic perimeter. An undulating roof completes the volume, while the north stand rises into two elevated wings connected to Maksimirska by a broad landscaped stair. In the survey area, the sports buildings are arranged as low pavilions along a north–south axis, with active roofs and open public spaces gradually leading toward Borongaj.
roundNoteHr: Za drugi krug ocjenjivački sud utvrdio je dodatne kriterije vrednovanja. Oni su obuhvaćali urbanistički koncept, kvalitetu i provedivost prijedloga, integraciju građevina i javnih prostora te organizacijske i oblikovne karakteristike pojedinih građevina, s posebnim naglaskom na prijedlog stadiona.

Generičke ili pretjerano ekspresivne konstrukcije, koje snažno određuju identitet stadiona, ali su zahtjevne u pogledu izvedbe ili troškova, ocijenjene su manje primjerenima zadanom programu i kontekstu. Slično se odnosilo na materijale zahtjevne za održavanje te pretjerano oslanjanje na vegetaciju unutar stadiona.
Važan kriterij eliminacije bila je i mogućnost fazne izgradnje, uz istodobno prepoznavanje arhitektonske kvalitete artikulacije programa.
roundNoteEn: For the second round, the jury established additional evaluation criteria. These included the urban concept, the quality and feasibility of the proposal, the integration of buildings and public spaces, and the organisational and formal qualities of the individual buildings, with particular emphasis on the stadium proposal.

Generic or overly expressive structures that strongly defined the stadium’s identity but presented significant challenges in terms of construction or cost were considered less appropriate to the programme and context. The same applied to high-maintenance materials and an excessive reliance on vegetation within the stadium.
The possibility of phased construction was also an important criterion for elimination, while the jury continued to recognise the architectural quality of the programme’s articulation.

entries.descriptionHr: Kupola obavija stadion kao propusna klimatska ovojnica, jasno odvojena od gledališta kružnim aktivacijskim prstenom koji sadrži javne i servisne programe, ophode i prostore okupljanja. Podnožje i vitki vodotoranj dodatno definiraju siluetu kompleksa i pojačavaju njegovu prisutnost unutar lokacije. U širem obuhvatu sportske dvorane i atletski sadržaji stapaju se s ozelenjenim humcima, jezerima i vijugavim stazama, dok se fragmenti srušenih građevina ponovno koriste u krajobrazu kao dio novog parkovnog sustava koji se proteže prema Borongaju.
entries.descriptionEn: The dome wraps the stadium as a porous climatic envelope, clearly separated from the seating bowl by a circular activation ring containing public and service programmes, concourses and gathering spaces. An earthen base and a slender water tower further define the complex’s silhouette and strengthen its presence within the site. In the survey area, sports halls and athletics facilities merge with planted mounds, lakes and winding paths, while fragments of demolished structures are reused within the landscape as part of a new park system extending towards Borongaj.
juryHr: Prijedlog razvija stadion kao „kuću unutar kuće“ i „grad unutar grada“ – mikrokozmos programa i prostora smještenih ispod propusne klimatske kupole. Središnja figura golemog mjerila djeluje poput urbane košnice: kompaktno gledalište oblikuje intenzivnu društvenu jezgru, dok je vanjska ovojnica zamišljena kao zaštitna, ventilirana i prilagodljiva klimatska opna. Između tih dviju struktura nastaje kružni aktivacijski prsten kao prijelazni prostor između stadiona, parka i grada.

Urbanistički koncept temelji se na zrcaljenju Maksimira i stvaranju kontinuiranog klimatskog krajobraza. Preostali sportski sadržaji ugrađeni su ispod ozelenjenih humaka i organizirani oko jezera, vijugavih staza i pristupačnih krovnih pejzaža, čime arhitektura u velikoj mjeri postaje podređena topografiji. Stadion snažne prisutnosti, apsolutne forme i pamtljive siluete uspostavljaju novu središnju figuru cijelog prostora.

Posebna kvaliteta projekta njegov je iznimno razrađen pristup održivosti i klimatskoj regulaciji. Heksagonalna ovojnica odgovara na orijentaciju, osunčanost i zahtjeve ventilacije, dok krajobraz djeluje kao infrastruktura za hlađenje, zasjenjenje, upijanje oborinskih voda i povećanje bioraznolikosti. Strategija kružnog gospodarenja dodatno uključuje ponovnu uporabu materijala postojećeg stadiona, čime održivost istodobno postaje tehnološko, ekonomsko i kulturno načelo. Jedinstvena forma artikulirana je u odnosu na program i okolišne uvjete, dok unutrašnjost funkcionira kao kolaž jednako pažljivo razmotrenih elemenata.

Prijedlog je konstrukcijski i tehnološki izrazito ambiciozan. Dvostruki sustav gledališta i goleme kupole, zajedno s iznimnim mjerilom nosive konstrukcije, otvara pitanja ekonomske izvedivosti, održavanja i dugoročne racionalnosti korištenja. Mjestimice monumentalna konstrukcija dominira unutaršnjim prostorima i samim stadionom, dopuštajući klimatskoj ovojnici da postane izraženija od programa koje bi trebala objediniti. Unatoč tome, projekt predstavlja izrazito koherentnu, pamtljivu i tipološki ambicioznu viziju stadiona kao klimatski reguliranog urbanog mikrokozmosa.
juryEn: The proposal develops the stadium as a ‘house within a house’ and a ‘city within a city’ - a microcosm of programmes and spaces contained beneath a porous climatic dome. The central figure of immense scale operates as an urban hive: the compact stadium bowl forms an intense social core, while the outer envelope is conceived as a protective, ventilated and adaptable climatic skin. Between the two structures, a circular activation ring emerges as an intermediate realm between stadium, park and city.

The urban concept is based on mirroring Maksimir and creating a continuous climatic landscape. The remaining sports facilities are embedded beneath planted mounds and organised around lakes, winding paths and accessible roofscapes, allowing architecture to become largely subordinate to topography. The stadium itself has a powerful presence, absolute form and memorable silhouette which establish a new central figure for the entire site.

A particular strength of the project is its exceptionally developed approach to sustainability and climatic regulation. The hexagonal envelope responds to orientation, solar exposure and ventilation requirements, while the landscape performs as infrastructure for cooling, shading, stormwater absorption and biodiversity. The circular-economy strategy further incorporates the reuse of materials from the existing stadium, making sustainability simultaneously a technological, economic and cultural principle. The singular form is articulated according to programme and environmental conditions, while the interior operates as a collage of equally considered elements.

The proposal is structurally and technologically highly ambitious. The dual system of the stadium bowl and the vast dome, together with the immense scale of the loadbearing structure, raises questions regarding economic feasibility, maintenance and long-term operational rationality. At times, the monumental structural grid overpowers the interior spaces and the stadium bowl itself, allowing the climatic envelope to become more dominant than the programmes it is intended to unify. Despite these reservations, the project presents a highly coherent, memorable and typologically ambitious vision of the stadium as a climatically regulated urban microcosm.

entries.descriptionHr: Pravilni, gotovo kvadratni volumen stadiona obavijen je kontinuiranim nizom vertikalnih lamela koje ujedinjuju pročelja i natkrivaju široki ulazni pojas. Krovna ploha spušta se prema otvoru igrališta, dok se glavni pristup formira kao prošireni zeleni predprostor. U anketnom dijelu sportske dvorane i atletika nižu se kao niski paviljoni uz parkovnu os, a Borongaj se rješava poluukopanom garažom s ozelenjenom javnom terasom.
entries.descriptionEn: A regular, almost square stadium volume is wrapped by a continuous field of vertical fins that unifies the façades and shelters the broad entrance zone. The roof plane slopes toward the pitch opening, while the main approach forms an enlarged green forecourt. In the survey area, sports halls and athletics are arranged as low pavilions along a park axis, while Borongaj is defined by a semi-sunken garage with a landscaped public terrace.
roundNoteHr: U prvom krugu ocjenjivački sud pregledao je sve pristigle radove. Nakon pojedinačnog razmatranja projekata i interne rasprave eliminirani su radovi koji, prema mišljenju ocjenjivačkog suda, nisu pokazali dovoljnu koherentnost urbanističkog pristupa, projektnog prijedloga ili izvedivosti.
Manje uspješnima ocijenjeni su i projekti bez dovoljno specifičnog identiteta, projekti s nedovoljno uvjerljivim odnosom prema gradu te prijedlozi pretjeranog mjerila ili zahtjevnog održavanja.
roundNoteEn: In the first round, the jury reviewed all submitted proposals. Following an examination of the individual projects and an internal discussion, the jury eliminated proposals that, in its opinion, lacked sufficient coherence in their urban approach, design concept or feasibility.

Projects without a sufficiently specific identity were also considered less successful, as were proposals with a less convincing relationship to the city and those characterised by excessive scale or demanding maintenance requirements.

entries.descriptionEn: A continuous domed surface, supported at eight points, encloses the seating bowl and defines the stadium’s low, recognisable silhouette. In the survey area, an urban network links the athletics stadium and halls embedded in green terrain with an elongated pedestrian corridor extending toward Borongaj.

entries.descriptionHr: Uzdužna otvorenost tribinske zdjele glavni je prostorni motiv stadiona. Kontinuirana donja zdjela nadopunjena je višim tribinama samo na istočnoj i zapadnoj strani, dok otvoreni sjeverni i južni završeci uspostavljaju vizualnu vezu s Maksimirskom šumom. Bijeli, horizontalno slojeviti volumen djelomično je ukopan i pristupa mu se postupnim usponom kroz javni krajobraz. U anketnom dijelu sportski sadržaji raspoređeni su unutar ortogonalne mreže zelenih trgova, šumskih fragmenata i livada, a Borongaj se oblikuje kao parkovni trg i prometno čvorište.
entries.descriptionEn: The longitudinal openness of the seating bowl is the stadium’s defining thing. A continuous lower bowl is complemented by upper tiers only along the east and west sides, while the open northern and southern ends establish a visual relationship with Maksimir Forest. The white, horizontally layered volume is partly embedded in the terrain and approached through a gradual ascent across the public landscape. In the survey area, sports facilities are arranged within an orthogonal network of green squares, forest fragments and meadows, while Borongaj is conceived as a park-like plaza and transit hub.
roundNoteHr: U šestom krugu razmatrani su projekti koji su bili visoko ocijenjeni u gotovo svim ključnim aspektima: programskom rješenju, urbanističkom smještaju, odnosu prema lokalnom kontekstu i arhitektonskoj artikulaciji.
U toj su fazi nijanse između preostalih projekata odredile izbor deset finalista, među kojima je ocjenjivački sud potom utvrdio konačni poredak i dodijelio nagrade.
roundNoteEn: In the sixth round, the jury considered projects that were highly regarded in nearly all key aspects, including programme, urban placement, relationship with the local context and architectural articulation.
At this stage, subtle differences between the remaining proposals determined the selection of the ten finalists, which the jury subsequently ranked and awarded.

entries.descriptionHr: „Plava tvrđava” prevodi identitet kluba u kompaktan, gotovo kvadratičan volumen stadiona, obavijen ritmom plavo-sivih polja i zatvoren prema van poput čvrstog urbanog bloka. Krov se spušta prema središnjem otvoru iznad igrališta, dok se unutrašnjost snažno odvaja od mirne vanjske pojavnosti kroz boju, navijačke rituale i kontinuiranu tribinsku zdjelu. U anketnom dijelu sportski kamp, atletika i dvorane povezuju se mrežom zelenih koridora i javnih ploha, a Borongaj se oblikuje kao glavno multimodalno čvorište i južni ulaz u kompleks.
entries.descriptionEn: The “Blue Fortress” translates the club’s identity into a compact, almost square stadium volume wrapped in a rhythm of blue-grey panels and closed outward like a solid urban block. The roof slopes toward the central opening above the pitch, while the interior contrasts sharply with the calm exterior through colour, supporter rituals and a continuous seating bowl. In the survey area, the sports campus, athletics facilities and halls are connected by a network of green corridors and public spaces, while Borongaj forms the main multimodal hub and southern gateway to the complex.

Pravokutna tribinska zdjela smještena je unutar slobodnije vanjske geometrije, a oko nje se razvija povišeni javni Korzo s muzejom, trgovinom, ugostiteljstvom i pogledima prema igralištu. U anketnom dijelu atletski stadion, dvorane i trening-tereni organizirani su kao niz povezanih urbanih polja i zelenih dvorišta.
entries.descriptionEn: The circular stadium volume is wrapped by a sequence of slender, inclined structural frames that give the façade the rhythm of unfolding flags, while the folded roof rises as a serrated crown derived from the silhouette of Medvednica. A rectangular seating bowl is set within the freer outer geometry, encircled by an elevated public Korzo containing the museum, shop, hospitality spaces and framed views into the pitch. In the survey area, the athletics stadium, sports halls and training grounds are organised as connected urban fields and green courtyards.

entries.descriptionEn: The stadium is conceived as a rounded, horizontal volume wrapped in a perforated aluminium envelope that follows a system of tensioned cables anchored to the ground. Between this outer structure and the seating bowl, a semi-covered perimeter concourse opens toward the park and the wider sports complex. In the survey area, low sports pavilions are arranged within a large public garden structured by a central green corridor and water features, while Borongaj is developed as a transport hub with a public plaza above an underground garage.

entries.descriptionHr: Gotovo cilindrični stadion obavijen je poluprozirnom dvostrukom ovojnicom koja se prema Maksimirskoj šumi otvara i povezuje unutrašnjost s parkom. Povišena javna platforma odvaja gledateljske od servisnih tokova. U anketnom dijelu dvorane oblikuju južni urbani potez, dok se prema sjeveru uvlače pod ozelenjene krovove. Kompleks povezuje os sjever–jug, završena svjetlosnim tornjem uz Borongaj.
entries.descriptionEn: The almost cylindrical stadium is wrapped in a semi-transparent double skin that opens toward Maksimir Forest and connects the interior with the park. An elevated public platform separates spectator and service flows. In the survey area, the halls form a southern urban frontage, while toward the north they recede beneath landscaped roofs. A north–south axis links the complex and terminates in a light tower beside Borongaj.
roundNoteHr: U petom krugu eliminirani su projekti koji su zauzimali prevelik dio lokacije i time otežavali faznu izgradnju, projekti čiji materijalni karakter nije odgovarao kontekstu, konceptualno manje uvjerljivi prijedlozi te rješenja čiji je pristup ocijenjen previše radikalnim za realnu izvedbu.
roundNoteEn: In the fifth round, the jury eliminated projects that occupied an excessive proportion of the site and thereby complicated phased construction, proposals whose material character was not appropriate to the context, conceptually less convincing solutions, and approaches considered too radical for realistic implementation.

entries.descriptionHr: Stadion je koncipiran kao niz horizontalnih, transparentnih prstenova nad kojima lebdi široki krov, stvarajući dojam svjetleće gradske lanterne. Otvorena pročelja otkrivaju unutarnje komunikacije i javne sadržaje, dok zaobljeni volumen omogućuje pristup sa svih strana. U anketnom dijelu sportski sadržaji ugrađeni su u kontinuirani zeleni sustav, povezan glavnom krajobraznom osi koja se od Maksimirskog parka spušta prema Borongaju.
entries.descriptionEn: The stadium is conceived as a sequence of horizontal, transparent rings beneath a broad floating roof, creating the appearance of a luminous urban lantern. entries.descriptionEn: The horseshoe-shaped stadium opens its northern end toward Maksimir Park, making the relationship between the stands and the landscape its defining spatial motif. In the survey area, the complex is developed as a “sports park” through concentric landscape rings connecting halls, athletics and recreational programmes within a continuous system of movement and planting.

entries.descriptionHr: Rad se ističe izrazito učinkovitim i dobro uravnoteženim urbanističkim konceptom, utemeljenim na istodobnoj prisutnosti intenzivno urbanog i intenzivno zelenog karaktera. Sportski grad oblikovan je kao integrirani sustav autonomnih arhitektonskih figura smještenih unutar kontinuiranog pejzaža. Posebno je uvjerljivo prepoznavanje glavnih urbanih pravaca: dijagonalne veze od prometnog čvorišta Borongaj, preko koso postavljenog atletskog stadiona, prema glavnoj osi parka Maksimir. Prometno čvorište nadilazi svoju infrastrukturnu ulogu i postaje velika javna platforma i ceremonijalni ulaz u kompleks – mjesto okupljanja i pripreme za sportski spektakl.
entries.descriptionEn: The proposal stands out for its highly efficient and well-balanced urban concept, based on the simultaneous presence of an intensely urban and intensely green character. The Sport City is conceived as an integrated system of autonomous architectural figures set within a continuous landscape. Particularly convincing is the recognition of the principal urban trajectories: a diagonal connection from the Borongaj transit hub, across the obliquely positioned athletics stadium, towards the main axis of Maksimir Park. The transit hub exceeds its infrastructural role to become a major public platform and ceremonial entrance to the complex - a place of gathering and preparation for the sporting spectacle.
juryHr: Identitet i duh izvornog stadiona Maksimir polazište su za koncepciju ovog prijedloga. Tribine su oblikovane kao niz lomljenih ploha koje istodobno nose krov, organiziraju komunikacije i uokviruju ulaze prema gradu i parku. Kompaktna forma gledališta zadržava zatvorenu i intenzivnu atmosferu utakmice, dok procjepi između tribina otvaraju stadion prema okolnoj šumi i javnim prostorima. U širem obuhvatu atletski stadion, sportske dvorane i prometni sadržaji postavljeni su kao autonomni volumeni unutar kontinuiranog šumskog pejzaža koji povezuje park Maksimir i Borongaj.

Stadion predstavlja značajan doprinos tipologiji suvremene komercijalne arene. Prijedlog inventivno reinterpretira izvorne kvalitete Turinina stadiona: lakoću lebdećih ploča, autonomiju tribina, monumentalnost konstrukcije i presudnu ulogu praznina. Četiri naizgled odvojena volumena tvore plastičnu, gotovo suprematističku kompoziciju naslaganih horizontalnih i kosih elemenata. Odnos konstrukcije, pejzaža i prostora između njih stvara snažnu, zagonetnu i prepoznatljivu siluetu, sposobnu postati novom ikoničkom figurom ovog dijela grada bez oslanjanja na konvencionalni formalni spektakl.

Fragmentacija vanjskog volumena ne umanjuje intenzitet unutarnjeg doživljaja. Forma stadiona zamišljena je kao kompaktan kondenzator kolektiva, uspostavljajući neposredan odnos između gledatelja i terena. Nogomet se interpretira kao kolektivni ritual, a stadion doživljava kao mjesto pripadnosti. Autonomna artikulacija sjeverne tribine čuva identitet legendarnog Sjevera i dodatno pojačava atmosferu utakmice. Jasna hijerarhija armiranobetonskih tribina i laganog čeličnog krova daje projektu istodobno sirov, robustan i lagan karakter. Ponavljanje, prefabrikacija i višestruke uloge dodijeljene primarnim elementima upućuju na racionalnu, ekonomičnu i izvedivu strukturu, minimalnog otiska i maksimalnog prostornog učinka.

Krajobrazni koncept uvjerljivo povezuje javni prostor, sportske programe i ekološku strukturu Maksimira. Kontrast između velikih trgova i sekvenci šumskog pejzaža uspostavlja jasan raspon od masovnih događanja do svakodnevne rekreacije. Otvorenost kompleksa, propusnost prizemne razine te sustav čistina, kišnih vrtova i pješačkih veza daju prijedlogu snažan javni karakter i omogućuju njegovo korištenje i izvan dana utakmica. Projekt nudi specifičan i ambiciozan odgovor na genius loci te predstavlja relevantan novi doprinos arhitekturi sporta.
Novi stadion, projektiran uz snažnu referencu na povijesnu strukturu, oblikuje jedinstven i specifičan prijedlog – ikonički gradski reper.
juryEn: The identity and the spirit of the original Maksimir Stadium are starting point for the conception of new proposal. The grandstands are formed by a sequence of folded planes that simultaneously support the roof, organise circulation and frame entrances toward the city and the park. The compact seating bowl preserves an enclosed match atmosphere, while the gaps between the stands open the stadium to the surrounding woodland and public spaces. In the survey area, the athletics stadium, sports halls and transport facilities are arranged as autonomous volumes within a continuous wooded landscape connecting Maksimir Park and Borongaj.

The stadium represents a significant contribution to the typology of the contemporary commercial arena. The proposal inventively reinterprets original qualities of Turina's stadium: the lightness of floating slabs, the autonomy of the grandstands, the monumentality of structure and the decisive role of voids. Four apparently separate volumes form a plastic, almost Suprematist composition of stacked horizontal and inclined elements. The relationship between structure, landscape and the spaces in between creates a strong, enigmatic and recognisable silhouette, capable of becoming a new iconic figure in this part of the city without relying on conventional formal spectacle.

The fragmentation of the external volume does not diminish the intensity of the internal experience. The bowl is conceived as a compact concentrator of the collective, establishing an immediate relationship between spectators and the pitch. Football is understood as a collective ritual and the stadium as a place of belonging. The autonomous articulation of the north stand preserves the identity of the legendary Sjever and further intensifies the atmosphere of the game. The clear hierarchy of reinforced-concrete stands and a lightweight steel roof gives the project a simultaneously raw, robust and light character. Repetition, prefabrication and the multiple roles assigned to primary elements indicate a rational, economical and buildable structure with a minimal footprint and maximum spatial effect.

The landscape concept convincingly connects public space, sports programmes and the ecological structure of Maksimir. The contrast between large mineral plazas and woodland sequences creates a clear range from mass event to everyday recreation. The openness of the complex, the permeability of the ground level, and the system of clearings, rain gardens and pedestrian links give the proposal a strong public character and support use beyond matchdays. The project offers a specific and ambitious response to the genius loci and constitutes a relevant new contribution to the architecture of sport.
The new Stadium, designed with a strong reference to historical structure, creates a unique and specific proposal - an iconic landmark for the City.

entries.descriptionEn: The stadium’s identity is defined by its exposed load-bearing structure. A translucent ETFE and polycarbonate envelope wraps three stands, while the north is treated as an enclosed acoustic shell containing a single uninterrupted supporters’ sector. In the survey area, the stadium, the compact Svetice campus and the Borongaj transport hub form three distinct zones connected by plazas, planted areas and pedestrian routes.

entries.descriptionHr: Stadion je uzdignut unutar parka, pri čemu su teren i donji prsten gledališta ukopani u oblikovani teren, dok se iznad njih uzdiže lagana transparentna konstrukcija gornjih tribina i krova. Baza stadiona oblikovana je kao kontinuirana topografija. U anketnoj zoni sportski su sadržaji smješteni uz rubove, čime se oslobađa središnja pješačka os koja povezuje Maksimirsku ulicu, sportske dvorane, atletske sadržaje i javni trg iznad terminala Borongaj.
entries.descriptionEn: The stadium is formed as a rise within the park, with the pitch and lower seating tier embedded in the shaped terrain, while a lightweight transparent structure of upper stands and roof rises above. juryHr: Prijedlog oblikuje stadion kao veliku horizontalnu nadstrešnicu koja lebdi iznad umjetne topografije. Veći dio programa ugrađen je u uzdignutu parkovnu topografiju, dok kružna natkrivena promenada iznad nje stvara novu javnu kontinuiranu šetnicu otvorenu prema parku i gradu. Odnos između terena, tribina i iznimno tanke krovne plohe projektu daje jasan identitet, istodobno povezan s neposrednim okruženjem i čitljiv u širem urbanom mjerilu.

Stadion djeluje kao paviljonski vidikovac unutar krajolika. Uzdignuta šetnica omogućuje panoramsko kretanje duž oboda građevine, dok filigranska konstrukcija i suzdržana upotreba materijala naglašavaju lakoću nadstrešnice. Prostorni koncept uspješno objedinjuje krov, promenadu i umjetnu topografiju u jedinstven sustav javnih prostora, stvarajući novu razinu tla iznad znatnog dijela funkcionalnog programa. Vanjski prostor preuzima vodeću ulogu: otvorenost, kontinuirane vizure i odnos sa zelenilom imaju prednost pred reprezentativnim karakterom zatvorenih interijera.

U urbanističkom mjerilu prijedlog nudi dominatnu artiklaciju stadionskog kompleksa. Nekoliko odnosa između građevina, glavnih pravaca kretanja i rubova obuhvata ostaje općenito definirano, zbog čega je cjelokupni javni prostor manje jasan od primarnog arhitektonskog koncepta stadiona.
juryEn: The proposal establishes the stadium as a large horizontal canopy hovering above an artificially shaped landscape. Most of the programme is embedded within the raised park topography, while the circular covered promenade above creates a new public level and a continuous walkway open towards the park and the city. This clear relationship between terrain, stands and an exceptionally thin roof plane gives the project a memorable and elegant identity, simultaneously connected to its immediate surroundings and legible at the wider urban scale.

The stadium appears as a kind of observatory within the landscape. The elevated walkway enables panoramic movement along the building perimeter, while the filigree structure and restrained material palette emphasise the lightness of the circular canopy. The spatial concept successfully combines roof, promenade and artificial topography into a single public system, creating a new ground plane above a substantial part of the functional programme. Exterior space assumes the leading role: openness, continuous views and the relationship with greenery are prioritised over the representational quality of enclosed interiors.

At the urban scale, the proposal offers a strong and easily memorable central stadium figure. Several relationships between buildings, principal movement routes and site edges remain general, leaving the overall public realm less clear than the primary architectural concept of the stadium.

Otvoreni podij između donjeg i gornjeg prstena vizualno odvaja gledalište od baze s pratećim sadržajima, stvarajući dojam lebdeće strukture. U anketnom dijelu stadion je smješten unutar kontinuiranog urbanog parka, dok sportske građevine zauzimaju rubove. Središnji zeleni koridor povezuje Maksimir s Borongajem, uz kišne vrtove i povremeno plavljive trgove.
entries.descriptionEn: The undulating geometry of the seating bowl defines the stadium’s outer form and continues into a lightweight translucent roof surface that rises and falls around the perimeter. An open podium between the lower and upper tiers visually separates the stands from the base containing supporting programmes, creating the appearance of a floating structure. In the survey area, the stadium sits within a continuous urban park, while sports buildings occupy the edges. A central green corridor links Maksimir with Borongaj, accompanied by rain gardens and temporarily floodable plazas.
roundNoteHr: Za drugi krug ocjenjivački sud utvrdio je dodatne kriterije vrednovanja. Oni su obuhvaćali urbanistički koncept, kvalitetu i provedivost prijedloga, integraciju građevina i javnih prostora te organizacijske i oblikovne karakteristike pojedinih građevina, s posebnim naglaskom na prijedlog stadiona.

Generičke ili pretjerano ekspresivne konstrukcije, koje snažno određuju identitet stadiona, ali su zahtjevne u pogledu izvedbe ili troškova, ocijenjene su manje primjerenima zadanom programu i kontekstu. Slično se odnosilo na materijale zahtjevne za održavanje te pretjerano oslanjanje na vegetaciju unutar stadiona.
Važan kriterij eliminacije bila je i mogućnost fazne izgradnje, uz istodobno prepoznavanje arhitektonske kvalitete artikulacije programa.
roundNoteEn: For the second round, the jury established additional evaluation criteria. Generic or overly expressive structures that strongly defined the stadium’s identity but presented significant challenges in terms of construction or cost were considered less appropriate to the programme and context. The same applied to high-maintenance materials and an excessive reliance on vegetation within the stadium.
The possibility of phased construction was also an important criterion for elimination, while the jury continued to recognise the architectural quality of the programme’s articulation.

entries.descriptionHr: Kružna geometrija stadiona uvedena je kao odgovor na nepravilnost lokacije, pri čemu se kompaktni volumen postavlja unutar kvadratnog javnog platoa. Kontinuirana tribinska zdjela obavijena je horizontalnim prstenovima sadržaja, dok blago valoviti krov oblikuje prepoznatljivu krunu iznad otvorenih gornjih ophoda i vidljive konstrukcije. U anketnom dijelu niski i djelomično ukopani sportski sadržaji raspoređeni su unutar proširenog zelenog sustava, a atletski stadion oblikovan je kao travnati nasip sa slendernim paviljonskim krovom.
entries.descriptionEn: The stadium’s circular geometry provides a response to the irregular site, placing a compact volume within a square public plaza. A continuous seating bowl is wrapped by horizontal rings of programme, while a gently undulating roof forms a recognisable crown above the open upper concourses and exposed structure. In the survey area, low and partly embedded sports facilities are arranged within an extended green system, while the athletics stadium is conceived as a landscaped mound marked only by a slender pavilion-like canopy.
roundNoteHr: U trećem krugu eliminirani su dobro razrađeni, ali generički projekti, prijedlozi hermetičnog odnosa prema javnom prostoru, projekti s nedovoljno razrađenim konstrukcijskim sustavom te financijski zahtjevna rješenja ili rješenja koja nisu dovoljno jasno izražavala primarni program.

Velik broj radova ponudio je dobro artikuliran, ali nedovoljno specifičan odnos prema lokaciji i njezinu nasljeđu. Posebno je zanimljiv bio projekt koji je zadržavao dijelove postojeće konstrukcije, no takav pristup nije bio izvediv zbog potrebe za njezinim uklanjanjem uslijed utvrđenih konstrukcijskih nedostataka.
roundNoteEn: In the third round, the jury eliminated projects that were well developed but generic, hermetic in their relationship with public space, insufficiently resolved in structural terms, financially demanding or unable to express the primary programme clearly.

entries.descriptionHr: Prijedlog se temelji na iznimno jasnoj urbanističkoj kompoziciji nekoliko geometrijski različitih elemenata – trokuta, linije, kruga i pravokutnika. Trokutasti trg uspostavlja dijagonalnu vezu između smjera Zvonimirove ulice i glavne osi Maksimira, dok linearna kralježnica povezuje južno prometno čvorište s parkom. Takva redukcija stvara lako razumljiv, čitljiv i pamtljiv sustav javnih prostora, iako mjerilo pojedinih volumena mjestimično sužava glavni pristupni koridor.
entries.descriptionEn: The proposal is based on an exceptionally clear urban composition of several geometrically distinct elements - a triangle, line, circle and rectangle. The triangular square establishes a diagonal connection between the direction of Zvonimirova Street and the main Maksimir axis, while the linear spine links the southern transport hub with the park. This reduction produces an easily understood, operationally legible and memorable system of public spaces, although the scale of several volumes locally narrows the principal access corridor.
juryHr: Stadion je zamišljen kao monumentalna, gotovo hramska građevina, a ne kao neutralna suvremena ovojnica. Dominantan trijem obavija gledalište i oblikuje zasjenjenu promenadu izrazite prostorne snage. Ritam konstrukcije daju pročelju snažnu plastičnost te uvjerljivo povezuju arhitektonski identitet, operativnu jasnoću i koherentan javni prostor. Primjena konvencionalnih građevinskih materijala djeluje neočekivano i osvježavajuće u kontekstu suvremenih stadiona.

Crvena betonska rebra uspostavljaju prepoznatljiv vanjski ritam stadiona i oblikuju niz dubokih arkada uz uzdignutu ulaznu esplanadu. Nosivi sustav postaje glavni arhitektonski izraz, dok se plave tribine te geometrija punog i praznog referiraju na identitet Dinama. U širem obuhvatu trokutasti trg, uzdužni pješački bulevar, kružna promenada oko bazena i atletskih sadržaja te južni blok dvorana organiziraju kompleks u jasno čitljiv sustav javnih prostora.

Projekt uspostavlja snažnu i odmah prepoznatljivu cjelinu. Integracija glavnog i pomoćnog stadiona, jasno slojevito razdvajanje korisničkih skupina i kompaktna organizacija pokazuju visoku razinu funkcionalne razrade. Kružna promenada povezuje bazen i atletske sadržaje te kompleksu daje pamtljiv identitet, ali istodobno zatvara neke od prirodnijih pristupa postojećem bazenu i smanjuje propusnost središnjeg dijela lokacije.

Najmanje uvjerljiv aspekt prijedloga leži u doslovnosti njegova simboličkog i grafičkog jezika. Crveno-plava koloristička shema djeluje nametnuto arhitektonskom jeziku koji je inače vrlo snažan. Odabrane boje nisu dosljedno povezane s tradicionalnim identitetom kluba i grada. Unatoč tome, jasnoća urbanističkog koncepta, monumentalna prisutnost i razumljiva funkcionalna organizacija čine ovaj prijedlog uvjerljivim i pamtljivim.
juryEn: The stadium is conceived as a monumental, almost temple-like building rather than as a neutral contemporary envelope. A large arcaded structure wraps the stadium bowl and forms a shaded promenade of considerable spatial authority. The structural rhythm and depth of the triangular openings give the facade a strong plastic quality and convincingly combine architectural identity, operational clarity and coherent public space. The use of conventional, robust construction materials appears unexpected and refreshing in the context of contemporary commercial stadia.

Red structural ribs establish the stadium’s distinctive external rhythm and form a sequence of deep arcades along the elevated entrance esplanade. The load-bearing system becomes the main architectural expression, while the blue stands and the geometry of solid and void refer to Dinamo’s identity. In the survey area, a triangular plaza, a longitudinal pedestrian boulevard, a circular promenade around the pool and athletics facilities, and the southern hall block organise the complex into a clearly legible system of public spaces.

The project establishes a strong and immediately recognisable whole. The integration of the main and training stadiums, the clear layered separation of user groups and the compact organisation demonstrate a high level of functional development. The circular promenade connects the swimming pool and athletics facilities and gives the complex a memorable identity, yet it also closes some of the more natural approaches to the existing pool and reduces the permeability of the central part of the site.

The weakest aspect of the proposal lies in the literal nature of its symbolic and graphic language. The red-and-blue colour scheme appears imposed upon an otherwise strong architectural logic, while the selected colours are not convincingly related to the traditional identity of the club and the city. Nevertheless, the clarity of the urban concept, monumental presence and understandable functional organisation make this a convincing and memorable proposal.

entries.descriptionHr: Ritam nagnutih vertikalnih nosača i prozračnih lamela oblikuje vanjski obod, dok blago valoviti krov stadionu daje horizontalnu, gotovo krajolišnu siluetu. Rotacijom volumena otvaraju se novi trgovi prema Maksimirskoj ulici, parku i južnom pristupu, a zeleni umetci ublažavaju masivnu bazu. U anketnom dijelu atletski stadion i dvorane povezuje zajednički arhitektonski jezik lukova, vertikala i valovitih krovova, dok Borongaj preuzima ulogu južnog prometnog ulaza u kompleks.
entries.descriptionEn: A rhythm of inclined vertical supports and permeable fins defines the outer perimeter, while the gently undulating roof gives the stadium a horizontal, landscape-like silhouette. The rotated volume opens new plazas toward Maksimirska Street, the park and the southern approach, while planted inserts soften the heavy base. In the survey area, the athletics stadium and sports halls share an architectural language of arches, vertical rhythms and wavy rooflines, while Borongaj functions as the complex’s southern transport gateway.
roundNoteHr: Za drugi krug ocjenjivački sud utvrdio je dodatne kriterije vrednovanja. Generičke ili pretjerano ekspresivne konstrukcije, koje snažno određuju identitet stadiona, ali su zahtjevne u pogledu izvedbe ili troškova, ocijenjene su manje primjerenima zadanom programu i kontekstu. Slično se odnosilo na materijale zahtjevne za održavanje te pretjerano oslanjanje na vegetaciju unutar stadiona.
Važan kriterij eliminacije bila je i mogućnost fazne izgradnje, uz istodobno prepoznavanje arhitektonske kvalitete artikulacije programa.
roundNoteEn: For the second round, the jury established additional evaluation criteria. Generic or overly expressive structures that strongly defined the stadium’s identity but presented significant challenges in terms of construction or cost were considered less appropriate to the programme and context. The same applied to high-maintenance materials and an excessive reliance on vegetation within the stadium.
The possibility of phased construction was also an important criterion for elimination, while the jury continued to recognise the architectural quality of the programme’s articulation.

entries.descriptionHr: Dijagonalno isprepletena aluminijska ovojnica obavija kompaktni stadion i stvara promjenjiv odnos refleksija, sjena i obojenih akcenata. Sjeverno pročelje preuzima odraze Maksimira, dok plavi pojas na jugu naglašava glavni pristup, a crveno-bijeli raster uvodi apstraktnu referencu na lokalne i nacionalne simbole. U anketnom dijelu atletski stadion, dvorane i tereni raspoređeni su unutar sustava zelenih otoka, drvoreda i pristupnih trgova koji povezuju park s Borongajem.
entries.descriptionEn: A diagonally interwoven aluminium envelope wraps the compact stadium, creating a changing interplay of reflections, shadows and coloured accents. The northern façade mirrors Maksimir Park, while a blue band marks the main southern entrance and a red-and-white grid introduces an abstract reference to local and national symbols. In the survey area, the athletics stadium, sports halls and training fields are arranged within a system of green islands, tree-lined routes and entrance plazas connecting the park with Borongaj.
roundNoteHr: U četvrtom krugu eliminirani su visoko ocijenjeni projekti koji nisu dovoljno uvjerljivo programski povezivali kompleks s neposrednim okruženjem ili nisu ostvarili dovoljno snažan kontekstualni odnos.
Ocjenjivački sud ipak je prepoznao ambicioznost pristupa i uvjerljivu razinu razrade pojedinih projekata.
roundNoteEn: In the fourth round, the jury eliminated highly rated projects that did not establish a sufficiently convincing programmatic relationship with their immediate surroundings or a sufficiently strong contextual response.
Nevertheless, the jury recognised the ambition of the approach and the convincing level of development demonstrated by several proposals.

entries.descriptionHr: Horizontalne aluminijske lamele prate fluidnu geometriju stadiona i tvore slojevitu ovojnicu koja se širi, sužava i mjestimično otvara prema ostakljenoj unutrašnjosti. Jugozapadni dio volumena produžen je u spiralnu rampu koja vodi do javno dostupnog krovnog parka s manjim nogometnim igralištem i pogledom prema tribinama. U anketnom dijelu kompleks je organiziran uz zakrivljenu natkrivenu promenadu koja povezuje Maksimir, sportske građevine i Borongaj te razdvaja nogometnu zonu od dvorana i atletike bez stvaranja čvrste granice.
entries.descriptionEn: Horizontal aluminium fins follow the stadium’s fluid geometry, forming a layered envelope that expands, contracts and periodically opens toward the glazed interior. The south-western part of the volume extends into a spiral ramp leading to a publicly accessible rooftop park with a small football pitch and views into the seating bowl. In the survey area, the complex is organised along a curved covered promenade connecting Maksimir Park, the sports buildings and Borongaj, separating the football zone from the halls and athletics without creating a hard boundary.
roundNoteHr: U petom krugu eliminirani su projekti koji su zauzimali prevelik dio lokacije i time otežavali faznu izgradnju, projekti čiji materijalni karakter nije odgovarao kontekstu, konceptualno manje uvjerljivi prijedlozi te rješenja čiji je pristup ocijenjen previše radikalnim za realnu izvedbu.
roundNoteEn: In the fifth round, the jury eliminated projects that occupied an excessive proportion of the site and thereby complicated phased construction, proposals whose material character was not appropriate to the context, conceptually less convincing solutions, and approaches considered too radical for realistic implementation.

entries.descriptionHr: Izložena konstrukcija i četiri jasno artikulirane tribine oblikuju stadion kao otvoreni urbani okvir oslonjen na aktivni podij koji sadrži javne programe, ulaze i ozelenjene terase. Sjeverna tribina kombinira kontinuirani zid navijača s natkrivenim javnim prostorom okrenutim prema parku Maksimir, dok istočna strana integrira glavnu i trening-tribinu. U širem obuhvatu sportski sadržaji grupirani su uz pješački bulevar koji povezuje Maksimir s Borongajem kroz livade, rubove šume, vrtove i krajobrazne sustave zadržavanja vode.
entries.descriptionEn: Exposed structure and four clearly articulated stands shape the stadium as an open urban frame anchored by an active podium containing public programmes, entrances and planted terraces. The north stand combines a continuous wall of supporters with a covered public space facing Maksimir Park, while the east side integrates the main and training stands. In the survey area, the sports facilities are grouped along a pedestrian boulevard linking Maksimir with Borongaj through meadows, forest fringes, gardens and water-retention landscapes.
juryHr: Urbana vrijednost prijedloga osobito je vidljiva u iznimno kvalitetnom krajobraznom projektu. Park Maksimir produžuje se prema jugu kroz prostrane livade, rubove šume, vrtove, infiltracijske bazene i pješačku promenadu u smjeru sjever–jug. Krajobraz se ne tretira kao rezidualni prostor između građevina, nego kao primarna infrastruktura koja povezuje sportske programe, znatno povećava udio javnih zelenih površina i uspostavlja novo urbano središte. Sustav otvorenih prostora omogućuje javni život tijekom cijelog dana, dok aktivirano podnožje stadiona oblikuje niz javnih prostora i terasa dostupnih i izvan režima sportskih događanja.

Stadion je zamišljen kao društvena infrastruktura, a ne kao zatvoren monumentalni objekt. Njegova temeljna kvaliteta proizlazi iz snažne dvojnosti: aktivna javna baza usmjerena je prema gradu i parku, dok je racionalna stadionska struktura podignuta iznad nje i intenzivno aktivirana tijekom utakmica. Takva hibridna organizacija unutar jedne jasne i demokratične strukture povezuje dva naizgled suprotstavljena programa – svakodnevnu javnu palaču za navijače i građane te suvremeni hram sporta.

Arhitektura je antimonumentalna, otvorena i izravna. Eksponirana konstrukcija i sirova materijalnost evociraju kvalitete nekadašnjeg stadiona i prevode ih u ekonomičan i prilagodljiv suvremeni sustav. Forma ne proizlazi iz autonomne skulpturalne geste, nego iz društvene aktivnosti, kretanja i korištenja prostora. Zapadna tribina djeluje kao urbana fasada kompleksa, dok uzdignuta javna baza posreduje između pješačkog mjerila i monumentalnosti tribina. Racionalan konstrukcijski i izvedbeni model, lokalno prilagođena vegetacija te krajobrazni sustavi jednostavni za održavanje uvjerljivo povezuju ekonomičnost i održivost.

Slabija strana prijedloga relativno je skromna artikulacija sadržaja ispod južne tribine. Za razliku od uvjerljive otvorenosti i robusnosti ostalih strana stadiona, njezin gornji dio poprima karakter konvencionalne poslovne zgrade, čime se djelomično slabi jedinstvo glavne arhitektonske ideje.
juryEn: The urban value of the proposal is particularly evident in its outstanding landscape project. Maksimir Park is extended southwards through extensive meadows, forest fringes, gardens, infiltration basins and a north-south pedestrian promenade. Landscape is not treated as residual space between buildings, but as the primary infrastructure connecting the sporting programmes, substantially increasing public green space and establishing a new urban centrality. The open-space system enables public life throughout the day, while the activated stadium base forms a sequence of public rooms and terraces accessible beyond the regime of sporting events.

The proposal conceives the stadium as social infrastructure rather than as an enclosed monumental object. Its fundamental quality lies in a strong duality: an active public base addresses the city and the park, while a rational stadium structure is lifted above it and intensively activated on match days. This hybrid organisation combines two seemingly opposing programmes within one clear and democratic structure - an everyday public palace for supporters and citizens, and a contemporary temple for sport.

The architecture is anti-monumental, open and direct. The exposed structure and raw materiality learn from the qualities of the former stadium while translating them into an economical and adaptable contemporary system. The form is not produced by an autonomous sculptural gesture, but through social activity, movement and occupation. The west stand acts as the urban facade of the complex, while the elevated public base mediates between the pedestrian scale and the monumentality of the stands. A rational structural and construction model, locally adapted planting and low-maintenance landscape systems convincingly connect economy and sustainability.

The critical point of the proposal is the relatively modest articulation of the programmatic infill of the south stand. In contrast to the convincing openness and robustness of the stadium's other sides, its upper section acquires the appearance of a conventional office building, partially weakening the unity of the main architectural idea.

Nevertheless, the project offers a strong and coherent response to the brief: the stadium as an open social platform, open house and flexible public infrastructure, whose architectural value emerges from everyday life rather than from representational form alone.

entries.descriptionEn: Most of the stadium is embedded within a newly formed hilly topography, leaving only the upper seating tier and exposed structural frame visible above the landscape. A large public platform, conceived as a “flying carpet”, hovers over the terrain and connects entrances, public programmes and a plaza facing Maksimir Park. In the survey area, the sports buildings sit on separate landscaped mounds linked by paths, clearings and public spaces shaped through the reuse of demolition material and excavated soil from the site.

U toj su fazi nijanse između preostalih projekata odredile izbor deset finalista, među kojima je ocjenjivački sud potom utvrdio konačni poredak i dodijelio nagrade.

entries.descriptionHr: Jedinstvena lagana nadstrešnica postaje glavni identitetski element kompleksa. Valovita silueta uspostavlja odnos s Medvednicom i krošnjama Maksimira, dok filtrirana svjetlost stvara zasjenjene prostore za svakodnevno korištenje i velika okupljanja.
entries.descriptionEn: A single lightweight canopy becomes the defining element of the complex. Its cable-net structure and ETFE membrane extend beyond the stadium, connecting sports facilities, public spaces, parkland and movement routes within a continuous urban landscape. Its undulating silhouette responds to Medvednica and Maksimir’s tree canopy, while filtered daylight creates shaded spaces for everyday use and large gatherings.

entries.descriptionHr: Horizontalne metalne lamele obavijaju zaobljeni volumen i naglašavaju slojevitu organizaciju stadiona, dok se široki krov blago podiže iznad kontinuiranog staklenog pojasa. Pristupi su oblikovani kao sustav usječenih rampi i monumentalnih stuba koje iz parkovnog terena vode prema povišenom ophodu. U anketnom dijelu dva prostorna rastera razdvaja središnja zelena „pukotina”, razvijena u pješačko-biciklističku promenadu koja povezuje Maksimir, sportske sadržaje i prometno čvorište Borongaj.
entries.descriptionEn: Horizontal metal fins wrap the rounded volume and emphasise the stadium’s layered organisation, while a broad roof rises gently above a continuous glazed band. Entrances are formed through a system of sunken ramps and monumental stairs leading from the park terrain to the elevated concourse. In the survey area, two spatial grids are separated by a central green “crack”, developed as a pedestrian and cycling promenade linking Maksimir Park, the sports facilities and the Borongaj transport hub.
roundNoteHr: U trećem krugu eliminirani su dobro razrađeni, ali generički projekti, prijedlozi hermetičnog odnosa prema javnom prostoru, projekti s nedovoljno razrađenim konstrukcijskim sustavom te financijski zahtjevna rješenja ili rješenja koja nisu dovoljno jasno izražavala primarni program.

Velik broj radova ponudio je dobro artikuliran, ali nedovoljno specifičan odnos prema lokaciji i njezinu nasljeđu. Posebno je zanimljiv bio projekt koji je zadržavao dijelove postojeće konstrukcije, no takav pristup nije bio izvediv zbog potrebe za njezinim uklanjanjem uslijed utvrđenih konstrukcijskih nedostataka.
roundNoteEn: In the third round, the jury eliminated projects that were well developed but generic, hermetic in their relationship with public space, insufficiently resolved in structural terms, financially demanding or unable to express the primary programme clearly.

A large proportion of the proposals offered a well-articulated but insufficiently specific response to the site and its legacy. A project that retained parts of the existing structure was considered particularly interesting, but this approach was not feasible because the structure had to be demolished due to identified structural deficiencies.

entries.descriptionHr: Monumentalni kameni raster u modulu 10x10 metara oblikuje stadion kao masiv isklesan iz hrvatskog krša, s dubokim otvorima, arkadama i sjenovitim javnim prolazima. Iznad mineralnog podnožja lebdi lagana membranska nadstrešnica oslonjena na drvene stupove i čelične nosače, dok unutrašnjost aktivira prostorni LED oblak. U anketnom dijelu Maksimirska se spušta u tunel, park prelazi preko stadiona, a glavne promenade povezuju Fan March, Sportski kampus, Steps of Fame i Borongaj.
entries.descriptionEn: A monumental 10×10 metre stone grid shapes the stadium as a mass carved from Croatian karst, with deep openings, arcades and shaded public passages. Above the mineral base, a lightweight membrane canopy floats on timber columns and steel trusses, while the interior is activated by a suspended spatial LED cloud. In the survey area, Maksimirska is placed in a tunnel, the park extends across the stadium, and the main promenades connect the Fan March, Sports Campus, Steps of Fame and Borongaj.

entries.descriptionHr: Fluidna metalna ovojnica oblikuje stadion kao zaobljeni volumen promjenjive visine, s valovitim krovnim rubom i kontinuiranim vertikalnim brazdama koje naglašavaju njegovu meku siluetu. Tribinska zdjela ostaje jasno odvojena od vanjskog plašta, dok se oko građevine razvijaju povišene šetnice, trkačke staze i javne terase. U anketnom dijelu ista se oblikovna logika prenosi na sportske dvorane, povezane nizom mostova, trgova i parkovnih poteza između Maksimira i Borongaja.
entries.descriptionEn: A fluid metallic envelope shapes the stadium as a rounded volume of varying height, with an undulating roofline and continuous vertical grooves emphasising its soft silhouette. The seating bowl remains clearly separated from the outer skin, while elevated promenades, running paths and public terraces develop around the building. In the survey area, the same formal language extends to the sports halls, linked by a sequence of bridges, plazas and landscaped routes between Maksimir Park and Borongaj.

entries.descriptionHr: Spuštena ovalna tribina i lagani zategnuti krov oblikuju stadion kao miran paviljon u parku, dok otvorena kolonada i prozračna vertikalna ovojnica zadržavaju prizemlje vidljivim i propusnim. Jedinstvena sjeverna tribina nastavlja se bez prekida u bočne tribine i koncentrira atmosferu prema terenu. U anketnom dijelu Maksimir se produžuje do Branimirove, promet i parkiranje spuštaju se ispod platoa, a mostovi, trgovi i zeleni potezi povezuju stadion, Svetice i Borongaj.
entries.descriptionEn: A sunken oval seating bowl and lightweight tensile roof shape the stadium as a calm pavilion in the park, while an open colonnade and breathable vertical veil keep the ground level visible and permeable. The unified north stand continues seamlessly into the side stands, concentrating the atmosphere toward the pitch. In the survey area, Maksimir Park extends toward Branimirova, traffic and parking are placed beneath the plateau, and bridges, plazas and landscaped routes connect the stadium, Svetice and Borongaj.
roundNoteHr: U četvrtom krugu eliminirani su visoko ocijenjeni projekti koji nisu dovoljno uvjerljivo programski povezivali kompleks s neposrednim okruženjem ili nisu ostvarili dovoljno snažan kontekstualni odnos.
Ocjenjivački sud ipak je prepoznao ambicioznost pristupa i uvjerljivu razinu razrade pojedinih projekata.
roundNoteEn: In the fourth round, the jury eliminated highly rated projects that did not establish a sufficiently convincing programmatic relationship with their immediate surroundings or a sufficiently strong contextual response.
Nevertheless, the jury recognised the ambition of the approach and the convincing level of development demonstrated by several proposals.

entries.descriptionHr: Dominatna kružna krovna ploha natkriva i objedinjuje tribine, komunikacije i terase, oblikujući stadion kao otvoreni monumentalni paviljon unutar krajolika. Prijedlog rješenja osigurava javni prostor izravno na razini glavne komunikacije, dok duboko, nastanjivo pročelje stvara natkrivene prijelaze između građevine i parka. U anketnom dijelu Maksimir se proširuje u sportski kampus sastavljen od urbanih šuma, livada, drvoreda i jasno definiranih trgova, međusobno povezanih pješačkim pravcima prema gradu i Borongaju.
entries.descriptionEn: A broad horizontal canopy unifies the stands, concourses and terraces, shaping the stadium as an open monument within the landscape. Raised topography brings the public realm directly to the main concourse level, while the deep inhabitable façade creates covered transitions between building and park. In the survey area, Maksimir extends into a sports campus composed of urban forests, meadows, tree-lined avenues and clearly defined squares, linked by pedestrian routes toward the city and Borongaj.
juryHr: Prijedlog se temelji na ideji integralnog pokrova zamišljenog kao velikog horizontalnog elementa koji stadion, javne prostore i prateće programe objedinjuje u jedinstvenu urbanu strukturu. Takav pristup projektu daje jasan identitet i snažan društveni karakter: stadion se ne razumije samo kao mjesto sportskog događaja, nego kao prošireni javni prostor namijenjen svakodnevnom korištenju stanovnika susjedstva, posjetitelja i navijača. Kompleks dodatnih sportskih sadržaja čini jasnu urbanističku cjelinu i uspostavlja čitljiv odnos između grada, parka i sportskog kampusa. Prostori ispod krova organizirani su kao grad unutar grada, s nizom manjih volumena i međuprostora koji podržavaju različite načine korištenja. Koncept naglašava otvorenost, kolektivni doživljaj i kontinuitet javnog života izvan vremena odigravanja utakmica, dok natkrivene površine stvaraju snažan okvir za okupljanje i boravak.

Zbog svoje kružne geometrije krov iskorištava vrlo velik dio raspoloživog prostora. Artikulacija kružnih i ovalnih volumena ispod krova slabi osnovnu ideju stadiona kao zajedničkog sučelja svakodnevnog života. Materijalni odnos između perforiranih betonskih elemenata i drvene obloge podgleda nadstrešnice djeluje nedovoljno koherentno.
juryEn: The proposal is based on the idea of a common canopy conceived as a large horizontal element that unifies the stadium, public spaces and supporting programmes into a single urban structure. This approach gives the project a clear identity and a strong social character: the stadium is understood not only as a sports venue, but as an extended public realm for the everyday use of neighbours, visitors and supporters. The complex of additional sports facilities forms a convincing urban argument and establishes a legible relationship between the city, the park and the sports campus.

The spaces beneath the roof are organised as a city within a city, with a sequence of smaller volumes and in-between spaces supporting different modes of use. The concept emphasises openness, collectivity and the continuity of public life beyond match days, while the extensive covered areas provide a strong framework for gathering and occupation.

Due to its circular geometry, the canopy occupies a very large proportion of the available land. The formal articulation of circular and oval volumes beneath the roof weakens the leading idea of the stadium as a common interface for everyday life. The material relationship between the perforated concrete elements and the timber-clad soffit of the canopy appears insufficiently coherent.

entries.descriptionHr: Radijalna konstrukcija od drva, čelika i betona ostaje potpuno izložena te stadion oblikuje kao otvoreni mehanički prsten s dubokim pročeljem i ritmom snažnih vanjskih okvira. Horizontalni potezi tribina, ophoda i ostakljenih etaža presijecaju konstrukcijski skelet, dok široki krov natkriva kružnu zdjelu. U anketnom dijelu kontinuirana prostorna „vrpca” povezuje Maksimir, atletiku, dvorane i Borongaj, pretvarajući se u biciklističku stazu, tribinsku nadstrešnicu, kolonade i pješačke veze.
entries.descriptionEn: A radial structure of timber, steel and concrete remains fully exposed, shaping the stadium as an open mechanical ring with a deep façade and a rhythm of powerful external frames. Horizontal bands of seating, concourses and glazed levels intersect the structural skeleton, while a broad roof covers the circular bowl. In the survey area, a continuous spatial “ribbon” links Maksimir, the athletics facilities, sports halls and Borongaj, becoming a cycle route, grandstand canopy, colonnade and pedestrian connector.
roundNoteHr: Za drugi krug ocjenjivački sud utvrdio je dodatne kriterije vrednovanja. Oni su obuhvaćali urbanistički koncept, kvalitetu i provedivost prijedloga, integraciju građevina i javnih prostora te organizacijske i oblikovne karakteristike pojedinih građevina, s posebnim naglaskom na prijedlog stadiona.

Generičke ili pretjerano ekspresivne konstrukcije, koje snažno određuju identitet stadiona, ali su zahtjevne u pogledu izvedbe ili troškova, ocijenjene su manje primjerenima zadanom programu i kontekstu. Slično se odnosilo na materijale zahtjevne za održavanje te pretjerano oslanjanje na vegetaciju unutar stadiona.
Važan kriterij eliminacije bila je i mogućnost fazne izgradnje, uz istodobno prepoznavanje arhitektonske kvalitete artikulacije programa.
roundNoteEn: For the second round, the jury established additional evaluation criteria. These included the urban concept, the quality and feasibility of the proposal, the integration of buildings and public spaces, and the organisational and formal qualities of the individual buildings, with particular emphasis on the stadium proposal.

Generic or overly expressive structures that strongly defined the stadium’s identity but presented significant challenges in terms of construction or cost were considered less appropriate to the programme and context. The same applied to high-maintenance materials and an excessive reliance on vegetation within the stadium.
The possibility of phased construction was also an important criterion for elimination, while the jury continued to recognise the architectural quality of the programme’s articulation.

Povišeni podij obavija građevinu i razdvaja javne pristupe od servisnog prizemlja. U anketnom dijelu niz sličnih bijelih sportskih volumena raspoređen je unutar „ekološke urbane platforme” parkova, trgova i zelenih koridora, dok visoki toranj označava novo čvorište Borongaj.
entries.descriptionEn: The white stadium is shaped as a rounded, layered volume with deep horizontal cornices and an almost continuous glazed base, appearing as an isolated object within a woodland clearing. A raised podium surrounds the building and separates public approaches from service access at ground level. In the survey area, a family of similarly moulded white sports buildings is distributed across an “ecological urban platform” of parks, plazas and green corridors, while a tall tower marks the new Borongaj transit hub.

entries.descriptionHr: Krov stadiona oblikovan je kao „Pleter kruna”: niz razgranatih drvenih stupova uzdiže se oko tribinske zdjele, međusobno se prepliće i nosi ritmičnu valovitu nadstrešnicu. Konstrukcija istodobno tvori pročelje, zasjenjenje i prepoznatljivu siluetu, dok zeleni nasipi i javni sadržaji omekšavaju podnožje građevine. U anketnom dijelu ista se logika prenosi na manje paviljone, nadstrešnice i parkovne elemente, povezane glavnom javnom rutom, dvama trgovima i krajobraznim potezom prema Borongaju.
entries.descriptionEn: The stadium roof is conceived as a “Pleter Crown”: a series of branching timber columns rises around the seating bowl, interweaving to support a rhythmic, undulating canopy. The structure simultaneously forms the façade, provides shading and creates a distinctive silhouette, while planted embankments and public programmes soften the building’s base. In the survey area, the same logic is applied to smaller pavilions, canopies and park elements, connected by a main public route, two plazas and a landscaped axis extending toward Borongaj.
roundNoteHr: U prvom krugu ocjenjivački sud pregledao je sve pristigle radove. Nakon pojedinačnog razmatranja projekata i interne rasprave eliminirani su radovi koji, prema mišljenju ocjenjivačkog suda, nisu pokazali dovoljnu koherentnost urbanističkog pristupa, projektnog prijedloga ili izvedivosti.
Manje uspješnima ocijenjeni su i projekti bez dovoljno specifičnog identiteta, projekti s nedovoljno uvjerljivim odnosom prema gradu te prijedlozi pretjeranog mjerila ili zahtjevnog održavanja.
roundNoteEn: In the first round, the jury reviewed all submitted proposals. Following an examination of the individual projects and an internal discussion, the jury eliminated proposals that, in its opinion, lacked sufficient coherence in their urban approach, design concept or feasibility.

Projects without a sufficiently specific identity were also considered less successful, as were proposals with a less convincing relationship to the city and those characterised by excessive scale or demanding maintenance requirements.

entries.descriptionHr: Ovoidni volumen stadiona organiziran je kao višeslojna urbana megastruktura u kojoj tribinska zdjela postaje jezgra šireg prstena komercijalnih, hotelskih i uredskih sadržaja. Vanjski obod djeluje kao kontinuirana ovojnica, dok su sjeverni uredski i južni hotelski toranj ugrađeni u njegov presjek; na krovu se razvija javna trkačka staza s rekreacijskim sadržajima i solarnom nadstrešnicom. U anketnom dijelu pomak stadiona prema zapadu otvara uzdužni zeleni javni potez i trgove, dok istočni rub preuzima aktivna komercijalna fronta.
entries.descriptionEn: The stadium is organised as an ovoid, multi-layered urban megastructure in which the seating bowl becomes the core of a broader ring of retail, hotel and office programmes. Its outer perimeter reads as a continuous envelope, while a northern office tower and southern hotel tower are embedded within the section; the roof is activated by a public running track, recreation areas and a solar canopy. In the survey area, shifting the stadium westward opens a longitudinal green civic route and plazas, while the eastern edge becomes an active commercial frontage.

entries.descriptionEn: The “Blue Fortress” is conceived as a massive layered arena with a flat roof and an inclined northern façade that steps back toward Maksimir Park. entries.descriptionEn: The stadium’s rounded crystalline volume emerges from a repetitive tetrahedral lattice that simultaneously shapes its structure, façade and roof.
