entries.descriptionHr: Stadion je oblikovan kao lebdeći prsten iznad kontinuiranog parkovnog krajolika. Povišena topografija vodi posjetitelje prema ulaznoj razini, dok vitka ovojnica i V-stupovi stvaraju dojam krova koji lebdi nad otvorenim parterom. Umjesto ogradama, tokovi i sigurnosne zone razdvajaju se terenom i različitim razinama. U anketnom dijelu sportske građevine ugrađene su u prošireni Maksimirski park, povezane zelenim promenadama i javnom infrastrukturom prema Borongaju.
entries.descriptionEn: The stadium is conceived as a floating ring above a continuous park landscape. Raised topography guides visitors toward the entrance level, while the slender envelope and V-shaped columns create the impression of a roof hovering above an open ground plane. Circulation and security zones are separated through terrain and levels rather than barriers. In the survey area, sports buildings are embedded within the expanded Maksimir Park and connected by landscaped promenades and public infrastructure extending toward Borongaj.
roundNoteHr: U petom krugu eliminirani su projekti koji su zauzimali prevelik dio lokacije i time otežavali faznu izgradnju, projekti čiji materijalni karakter nije odgovarao kontekstu, konceptualno manje uvjerljivi prijedlozi te rješenja čiji je pristup ocijenjen previše radikalnim za realnu izvedbu.
roundNoteEn: In the fifth round, the jury eliminated projects that occupied an excessive proportion of the site and thereby complicated phased construction, proposals whose material character was not appropriate to the context, conceptually less convincing solutions, and approaches considered too radical for realistic implementation.

entries.descriptionHr: Kompaktni kružni stadion sužava se prema krovnoj kruni, dok ritam nagnutih zatega i vertikalnih lamela oblikuje duboku, prozračnu ovojnicu koja istodobno nosi krov i filtrira poglede prema unutrašnjosti. Aktivno prizemlje s muzejom, trgovinama i ugostiteljskim sadržajima otvara građevinu prema parku, a pomoćna tribina uklapa se pod glavno gledalište. U anketnom dijelu svi sportski sadržaji povezuju se kontinuiranim zelenim javnim prostorom bez površinskog parkiranja, dok jedinstvena sportska dvorana objedinjuje atletiku i dvije arene.
entries.descriptionEn: The compact circular stadium tapers toward its roof crown, while a rhythm of inclined tension supports and vertical fins forms a deep permeable envelope that both carries the roof and filters views into the interior. An active ground floor with a museum, shops and hospitality spaces opens the building toward the park, while the auxiliary stand is integrated beneath the main seating structure. In the survey area, all sports facilities are connected by a continuous green public realm free of surface parking, while a single sports hall consolidates athletics and two indoor arenas.
roundNoteHr: U trećem krugu eliminirani su dobro razrađeni, ali generički projekti, prijedlozi hermetičnog odnosa prema javnom prostoru, projekti s nedovoljno razrađenim konstrukcijskim sustavom te financijski zahtjevna rješenja ili rješenja koja nisu dovoljno jasno izražavala primarni program.

Velik broj radova ponudio je dobro artikuliran, ali nedovoljno specifičan odnos prema lokaciji i njezinu nasljeđu. Posebno je zanimljiv bio projekt koji je zadržavao dijelove postojeće konstrukcije, no takav pristup nije bio izvediv zbog potrebe za njezinim uklanjanjem uslijed utvrđenih konstrukcijskih nedostataka.
roundNoteEn: In the third round, the jury eliminated projects that were well developed but generic, hermetic in their relationship with public space, insufficiently resolved in structural terms, financially demanding or unable to express the primary programme clearly.

A large proportion of the proposals offered a well-articulated but insufficiently specific response to the site and its legacy. A project that retained parts of the existing structure was considered particularly interesting, but this approach was not feasible because the structure had to be demolished due to identified structural deficiencies.

entries.descriptionHr: Monumentalni kvadratni okvir stadiona oslonjen je na dvanaest masivnih tornjeva, između kojih se otvaraju duboki urbani prolazi prema uzdignutoj javnoj promenadi. Iznad kontinuirane zdjele gledališta lagana krovna konstrukcija djeluje kao da lebdi, dok propusne metalne zavjese djelomično zatvaraju uglove i otkrivaju slojevitu unutarnju strukturu građevine. U širem obuhvatu središnja „Ulica Sporta“ povezuje Maksimir s Borongajem, razdvaja sigurnosno zatvoreniji stadionski kompleks od otvorenog kampusa te organizira niz dvorana, trgova i krajobrazno oblikovanih čistina.
entries.descriptionEn: A monumental square stadium frame is anchored by twelve massive towers, with deep urban gateways opening between them toward an elevated public concourse. Above the continuous seating bowl, a lightweight roof appears to float, while permeable metal curtains partially enclose the corners and reveal the building’s layered interior. In the survey area, a central “Street of Sport” links Maksimir with Borongaj, separates the more secure stadium complex from the open sports campus, and organises a sequence of halls, plazas and landscaped clearings.
juryHr: Prijedlog oblikuje veliki javni park kao produžetak Maksimira, unutar kojega su sportski programi raspoređeni kao autonomni elementi. Urbana struktura jasno je organizirana oko središnje osi prema kojoj gravitiraju svi programi. Ta os povezuje prometno čvorište, sportske sadržaje i ulaz u park Maksimir te funkcionira kao glavna javna promenada i prostorna okosnica budućeg Grada sporta. Kontinuirani raster stabala daje kompleksu snažan javni i krajobrazni karakter, dok raspored programa unutar parka stvara niz prepoznatljivih urbanih prostora i omogućuje svakodnevno korištenje neovisno o velikim sportskim događanjima.

Kolaž se koristi kao osnovna metoda artikulacije. Pojedine zgrade, otvoreni prostori i krajobrazni elementi zadržavaju vlastiti identitet, a istodobno tvore koherentan sustav. Takav pristup uvjerljivo odgovara na složenost lokacije i stvara robustan, otvoren i suvremen sportski kampus. Arhitektura nije zamišljena kao zatvoren sklop, već kao zbir javnih institucija smještenih unutar parka, pri čemu središnja os cijelom sustavu daje prostornu jasnoću i čitljivost.

Stadion je određen snažnim dvojnim karakterom: intenzitet kompaktne unutarnje arene suprotstavljen je otvorenosti prema gradu i krajoliku. Kontinuirana i precizno oblikovana zdjela stvara koncentriranu, sugestivnu atmosferu suvremenog nogometnog hrama. Istodobno niz masivnih stupova raspoređenih duž perimetra nosi uzdignute lođe i javne prostore usmjerene prema okolini. Ceremonijalna stubišta, otvorena vrata i kontinuirana javna promenada pretvaraju stadion u zajednički urbani sustav koji ostaje dostupan, nastanjiv i čitljiv i izvan dana utakmica. Njegova monumentalnost proizlazi iz ritma konstrukcije, a ne iz zatvorenosti volumena.

Kombinacija precizno oblikovane gledališne arene, otvorenih javnih prostora i kolaža arhitektonskih elemenata daje projektu snažan identitet te predstavlja relevantan doprinos suvremenoj sportskoj arhitekturi. Stadion istodobno funkcionira kao sportska građevina i javni prostor. Prijedlog je apstraktan i dovoljno otvoren da prihvati različite obrasce korištenja, dok veliki park i pješačka mreža pružaju uvjerljiv okvir za dugoročni razvoj cijelog kompleksa.

Prijedlog je prezentiran suzdržano u odnosu na ambiciju i prostorni potencijal samog koncepta, zbog čega nekoliko važnih odnosa ostaje nedovoljno elaborirano. Snažna simetrična koncepcija stadiona uspješno objedinjuje unutarnji prostor i stvara sugestivnu atmosferu gledališta, no njezina jednaka primjena na sve strane manje je uvjerljiva.
juryEn: The proposal creates a vast public park as an extension of Maksimir, within which the sports programmes are distributed as autonomous elements. The urban structure is clearly organised around a central axis towards which all programmes gravitate. This axis connects the transport hub, the sports facilities and the entrance to Maksimir Park, functioning as the principal public promenade and the spatial backbone of the future City of Sport. A continuous carpet of trees gives the complex a strong civic and landscape character, while the distribution of programmes within the park creates a sequence of distinct urban rooms and supports everyday use beyond major sporting events.

Collage is employed as the principal method of articulation. The individual buildings, open spaces and landscape elements retain their own identity while forming a coherent system. This approach responds convincingly to the complexity of the site and produces a robust, open and contemporary sports campus. The architecture is not conceived as a closed ensemble, but as a collection of public institutions embedded within the park, with the central axis providing spatial authority and legibility to the whole.

The stadium is defined by a strong dual character: the intensity of a compact inner arena is contrasted with openness towards the city and the landscape. The continuous and precisely formed bowl creates the concentrated, suggestive atmosphere of a contemporary football temple. At the same time, a series of heavy columns distributed along the perimeter supports elevated loggias and public rooms facing the surroundings. Ceremonial stairways, open gates and a continuous public concourse transform the stadium into a communal system that remains accessible, inhabitable and legible beyond matchdays. Its monumentality is generated through the rhythm of structure rather than through the closure of the volume.

The combination of the precise bowl, open civic spaces and a collage of architectural elements gives the project a strong identity and represents a relevant contribution to contemporary sports architecture. The stadium simultaneously operates as a sporting arena, a civic building and a public space. The proposal is abstract and sufficiently open to accommodate different patterns of use, while the large park and pedestrian network provide a convincing framework for the long-term development of the entire complex.

The proposal is presented somewhat modestly in relation to the ambition and spatial potential of its concept, leaving several important relationships insufficiently demonstrated. The strong symmetrical conception of the stadium successfully unifies the interior and produces the suggestive atmosphere of the bowl; however, its equal application to all external sides is less convincing.

entries.descriptionHr: Monolitne betonske plohe stadiona izrastaju iz modeliranog terena poput niza velikih nagnutih nadstrešnica, spajajući tribinsku zdjelu s okolnim parkom bez klasične fasadne ovojnice. Ulazi se otvaraju na uglovima, dok otvoreni ophodi ostaju izravno povezani s krajolikom i vode prema kompaktnom gledalištu. U anketnom dijelu sportski sadržaji uranjaju u brežuljke, udoline i kišne vrtove, a ukopani tereni, zeleni krovovi i pješačke staze stvaraju kontinuirani park od Maksimira do Borongaja.
entries.descriptionEn: Monolithic concrete planes rise from the modelled terrain as a sequence of large inclined canopies, joining the seating bowl to the surrounding park without a conventional façade enclosure. Entrances open at the corners, while the open concourses remain directly connected to the landscape and lead toward the compact arena. In the survey area, sports facilities are embedded within hills, valleys and rain gardens, while sunken fields, planted roofs and pedestrian paths create a continuous park extending from Maksimir to Borongaj.

Ocjenjivački sud ipak je prepoznao ambicioznost pristupa i uvjerljivu razinu razrade pojedinih projekata.
roundNoteEn: In the fourth round, the jury eliminated highly rated projects that did not establish a sufficiently convincing programmatic relationship with their immediate surroundings or a sufficiently strong contextual response.
Nevertheless, the jury recognised the ambition of the approach and the convincing level of development demonstrated by several proposals.

entries.descriptionHr: Poluprozirna nadstrešnica obuhvaća tribinu poput velikog šatora postavljenog na monumentalnu stepenastu bazu. Ritam vitkih stupova i jednolična svijetla ovojnica daju stadionu laganu, gotovo paviljonsku prisutnost, dok se široke stube pretvaraju u javni auditorij i ulazni trg. U anketnom dijelu stadion, dvorane i prometno čvorište organizirani su kao povezani „funkcionalni otoci”, između kojih se nižu manji zeleni otočići, amfiteatri, retencijsko jezero i rekreacijske zone na osi Trga J. F. Kennedyja i Maksimira.
entries.descriptionEn: A semi-transparent canopy encloses the seating bowl like a large tent resting on a monumental stepped base. A rhythm of slender columns and a uniform pale envelope gives the stadium a light, almost pavilion-like presence, while the broad staircase becomes a public auditorium and entrance plaza. In the survey area, the stadium, sports halls and transit hub are organised as connected “functional islands”, with smaller landscaped islets, amphitheatres, a retention pond and recreation areas arranged along the axis between J. F. Kennedy Square and Maksimir Park.
roundNoteHr: U šestom krugu razmatrani su projekti koji su bili visoko ocijenjeni u gotovo svim ključnim aspektima: programskom rješenju, urbanističkom smještaju, odnosu prema lokalnom kontekstu i arhitektonskoj artikulaciji.
U toj su fazi nijanse između preostalih projekata odredile izbor deset finalista, među kojima je ocjenjivački sud potom utvrdio konačni poredak i dodijelio nagrade.

entries.descriptionHr: Sportski kompleks koncipiran je kao skup autonomnih volumena smještenih unutar nove urbane šume. Takav pristup uspostavlja snažan krajobrazni okvir shvaćen kao južni produžetak Maksimira. Pješački pristup iz smjera središta grada uspješno se usmjerava prema uzdignutom javnom platou stadiona, stvarajući jasan slijed dolaska i snažnu vezu između grada, parka i sportske infrastrukture. Rotacija stadiona formira trokutasti park i izduženi uzdignuti plato otvoren prema gradu što obogaćuje i dinamizira kontaktne zone.
entries.descriptionEn: The proposal conceives the sports complex as a collection of autonomous volumes placed within a new urban forest. This approach establishes a strong landscape framework understood as a southern extension of Maksimir. The pedestrian approach from the city centre is successfully directed towards the elevated public stadium plaza, creating a clear sequence of arrival and a strong relationship between the city, park and sports infrastructure. The rotation of the stadium forms a triangular park and a long elevated plaza, although its urban justification is not fully convincing and locally produces complex edges and fenced zones.
juryHr: Lebdeći krov uzdiže se iznad niza manjih fragmenata, dok otvoreno i transparentno prizemlje zadržava izravnu vezu s parkom. Tri blage rampe vode posjetitelje na uzdignuti podij, a šuma se proteže kroz bazu građevine, ublažavajući prijelaz prema gledalištu. U anketnoj zoni sportski su sadržaji organizirani unutar mreže urbanih šuma, trgova i pješačke osi sjever–jug, stvarajući zeleni koridor između Maksimira, Borongaja i Savice.

Kontinuirani omotač dvostruke, dvoetažne lođe oblikuje prostranu uzdignutu promenadu i terasu usmjerenu prema gradu kao mjesto susreta. Javna razina omogućuje istodobne vizure prema okolnom parku, pomoćnim igralištima i gradu, dajući stadionu urbani karakter, a ne isključivo karakter zatvorenog sportskog objekta. Gusto polje vitkih stupova tvori snažan, ritmičan i porozan vanjski sloj, iza kojega se pojavljuju dva krovna sustava različite geometrije i materijalnog izraza – jedan translucentan, a drugi neproziran.

Krajobrazni koncept urbane šume kontinuirano povezuje pojedinačne građevine i prijedlogu daje jasnu ambijentalnu i ekološku dimenziju. Paviljonska organizacija omogućuje autonomiju pojedinih sadržaja, ali istodobno slabi dojam cjelovitosti prostornog rješenja.
Doprinos prijedloga leži u ostvarenom javnom prostoru koji proizlazi iz otklonjenog položaja volumena stadiona u odnosu na Maksimirsku ulicu.
juryEn: A floating roof rises above a series of smaller pavilion-like volumes, while the open and transparent ground level maintains a direct connection with the park. Three gentle ramps lead visitors onto the raised podium, and the forest extends through the building’s base, softening the transition toward the seating bowl. In the survey area, sports facilities are arranged within a network of urban forests, plazas and a north–south pedestrian axis, creating a green corridor between Maksimir, Borongaj and Savica.

A continuous wrapping of a double, two-level loggia creates a generous elevated promenade and terrace facing the city. This public level allows simultaneous views towards the surrounding park, auxiliary pitches and the city, giving the stadium the character of an urban building rather than an exclusively enclosed sporting venue. A dense field of slender columns forms a strong, rhythmic and porous outer layer, behind which two roof systems of different geometry and material expression appear - one translucent and one opaque.

The urban-forest landscape concept consistently connects the individual buildings of the complex and gives the proposal a clear ecological and temporal dimension. The pavilion organisation allows the programmes to operate autonomously, but also weakens the immediate spatial cohesion of the whole.
The main strength of the proposal lies in its generous elevated public promenade resulting from the rotated position of the stadium volume and its ambitious interpretation of the urban forest.

entries.descriptionHr: Oštra, biomorfna čelična konstrukcija obavija stadion poput prostornog egzoskeleta, a ponavljajući razgranati elementi istodobno nose krov, oblikuju pročelje i stvaraju prepoznatljivu nazubljenu siluetu. Tribinska zdjela ostaje uvučena unutar laganog prstena, dok se park spušta ispod građevine i pretvara u javne prolaze, vodene krajolike i termalne kupelji. U anketnom dijelu sportske dvorane, atletika i rekreacijski sadržaji raspoređeni su unutar kontinuiranog topografskog parka povezanog mrežom slobodnih pješačkih putanja.
entries.descriptionEn: A sharp biomorphic steel structure wraps the stadium like a spatial exoskeleton, with repeated branching elements simultaneously supporting the roof, shaping the façade and producing a distinctive serrated silhouette. The seating bowl is recessed within the lightweight ring, while the park descends beneath the building and transforms into public passages, water landscapes and thermal baths. In the survey area, sports halls, athletics and recreational facilities are distributed across a continuous topographic park connected by a loose network of pedestrian routes.
roundNoteHr: U petom krugu eliminirani su projekti koji su zauzimali prevelik dio lokacije i time otežavali faznu izgradnju, projekti čiji materijalni karakter nije odgovarao kontekstu, konceptualno manje uvjerljivi prijedlozi te rješenja čiji je pristup ocijenjen previše radikalnim za realnu izvedbu.
roundNoteEn: In the fifth round, the jury eliminated projects that occupied an excessive proportion of the site and thereby complicated phased construction, proposals whose material character was not appropriate to the context, conceptually less convincing solutions, and approaches considered too radical for realistic implementation.

entries.descriptionHr: Organska, parametarski oblikovana ovojnica objedinjuje stadion u zaobljenu, gotovo lebdeću cjelinu, dok veliki otvori i lagani fasadni paneli zadržavaju prozračnost volumena. Pješački most povezuje Maksimirski park sa sportskim kompleksom te se kroz niz rampi, terasa i vidikovaca nastavlja prema Borongaju. U anketnom dijelu dvorane i javni sadržaji oblikovani su kao fluidni paviljoni uronjeni u mrežu trgova, zelenih koridora i rekreacijskih prostora.
entries.descriptionEn: An organic, parametrically designed envelope unifies the stadium into a rounded, almost floating volume, while large openings and lightweight façade panels preserve its visual permeability. A pedestrian bridge connects Maksimir Park with the sports complex and continues toward Borongaj through a sequence of ramps, terraces and viewing platforms. In the survey area, the halls and public facilities are conceived as fluid pavilions embedded within a network of plazas, green corridors and recreational spaces.
roundNoteHr: U prvom krugu ocjenjivački sud pregledao je sve pristigle radove. Nakon pojedinačnog razmatranja projekata i interne rasprave eliminirani su radovi koji, prema mišljenju ocjenjivačkog suda, nisu pokazali dovoljnu koherentnost urbanističkog pristupa, projektnog prijedloga ili izvedivosti.
Manje uspješnima ocijenjeni su i projekti bez dovoljno specifičnog identiteta, projekti s nedovoljno uvjerljivim odnosom prema gradu te prijedlozi pretjeranog mjerila ili zahtjevnog održavanja.
roundNoteEn: In the first round, the jury reviewed all submitted proposals. Following an examination of the individual projects and an internal discussion, the jury eliminated proposals that, in its opinion, lacked sufficient coherence in their urban approach, design concept or feasibility.

Projects without a sufficiently specific identity were also considered less successful, as were proposals with a less convincing relationship to the city and those characterised by excessive scale or demanding maintenance requirements.

entries.descriptionHr: Prijedlog uspostavlja uređeni sustava volumena, javnih platformi i komunikacija, čija međuodnos proizlazi iz položaja postojećeg bazenskog kompleksa Svetice. Taj početni koordinatni sustav postaje osnova preciznog urbanističkog plana budućeg sportskog kampusa, omogućujući da se postojeći i novi programi čitaju kao dijelovi koherentne prostorne cjeline.
entries.descriptionEn: The proposal demonstrates a clear ambition to establish a regulated system of volumes, public platforms and circulation, with its geometry derived from the disposition of the existing Svetice swimming complex. This initial coordinate system becomes the basis of a precise masterplan for the future sports campus, allowing existing and new programmes to be read as parts of a coherent spatial whole.
juryHr: Stadion je organiziran kao arena upuštena u uzdignuti trg i okružena racionalnim, ritmičnim rasporedom servisnih i pratećih programa. Sustav slojevitih pješačkih razina uvodi novi javni parter iznad logističke i prometne infrastrukture, povezujući Maksimir, Svetice i Borongaj. Koncept "grada iznad grada" jasno razdvaja javne i servisne tokove te prijedlogu daje snažnu infrastrukturnu logiku.

Translucentna ovojnica lebdi iznad masivne, nastanjene baze stadiona, otkrivajući laganu čeličnu konstrukciju koja se prema javnom podiju spušta poput velike rešetkaste zavjese. Stubišta, servisni volumeni i zelenilo integrirani su u postament, dok je logistika skrivena ispod uzdignutog javnog partera. U anketnom dijelu paralelni programski sadržaji, izvedeni iz osi bazenskog kompleksa Svetice, uspješno organiziraju atletiku, dvorane, vanjska igrališta i Borongaj u sustav platformi koje povezuju Maksimir s novim javnim sportskim krajolikom.

Kruto pridržavanje početnog koordinatnog sustava rezultira nizom uskih prolaza i malih stubišta unutra stadiona koja ne uspijevaju uspostaviti jasnu prostornu hijerarhiju ni uvjerljivu dominantu unutar otvorenih i zatvorenih prostora okupljanja. Potencijal kosih krovnih ploha nije iskorišten za stvaranje primjernih natkrivenih javnih prostora. Sjeverni trg podređen je ulazu u javnu garažu, dok opsežna uporaba ukopanih prostora dodatno smanjuje otvorenost i neposrednost javnog partera.
juryEn: The stadium is organised as an arena recessed into an elevated plaza and encircled by a rational, rhythmic distribution of services and supporting programmes. A system of layered pedestrian levels introduces a new public ground above logistics and transport infrastructure, connecting Maksimir, Svetice and Borongaj. The concept of a city above the city clearly separates public and operational flows and gives the proposal a strong systemic and infrastructural logic.

A translucent envelope floats above the stadium’s massive inhabited base, revealing a lightweight steel structure that descends toward the public podium as a large lattice veil. Stairs, cubic volumes and planting are embedded within the plinth, while logistics are concealed beneath the elevated civic ground. In the survey area, parallel programme bands derived from the axis of the Svetice swimming complex organise athletics, halls, outdoor fields and Borongaj into a system of platforms linking Maksimir with a new public sports landscape.

The rigid adherence to the initial coordinate system produces a sequence of narrow passages and small staircases that fail to establish a clear spatial hierarchy or convincing dominance within the open and enclosed gathering spaces. The pedestrian routes, particularly their offsets along the stadium, are too narrow in relation to the scale and capacity of the new building. The potential of the sloping roof planes is not used to generate generous covered public spaces. The northern square is subordinated to the public garage entrance, while the extensive use of sunken areas further reduces the openness and immediacy of the public ground.

entries.descriptionHr: Pet horizontalnih zelenih pojaseva obavija kompaktni volumen stadiona i prenosi logiku maksimirskih staza na njegov parter, terase i pročelje. Iznad ritma vitkih stupova lebdi široki zaobljeni krov, dok otvorene promenade, aktivna prizemlja i ozelenjene etaže ublažavaju mjerilo tribinske zdjele i povezuju je s parkom. U anketnom dijelu mreža trgova, pješačkih ruta i zelenih koridora organizira atletiku, dvorane, bazen, nogometni kampus i Borongaj kao jedinstven sportski distrikt za svakodnevno korištenje.
entries.descriptionEn: Five horizontal planted bands wrap the stadium’s compact volume, translating the logic of Maksimir’s paths into its ground plane, terraces and façade. A broad rounded roof floats above a rhythm of slender columns, while open concourses, active ground floors and planted levels soften the scale of the seating bowl and connect it to the park. In the survey area, a network of plazas, pedestrian routes and green corridors organises athletics, sports halls, the swimming complex, football campus and Borongaj as a unified sports district for everyday use.
roundNoteHr: U trećem krugu eliminirani su dobro razrađeni, ali generički projekti, prijedlozi hermetičnog odnosa prema javnom prostoru, projekti s nedovoljno razrađenim konstrukcijskim sustavom te financijski zahtjevna rješenja ili rješenja koja nisu dovoljno jasno izražavala primarni program.

Velik broj radova ponudio je dobro artikuliran, ali nedovoljno specifičan odnos prema lokaciji i njezinu nasljeđu. Posebno je zanimljiv bio projekt koji je zadržavao dijelove postojeće konstrukcije, no takav pristup nije bio izvediv zbog potrebe za njezinim uklanjanjem uslijed utvrđenih konstrukcijskih nedostataka.
roundNoteEn: In the third round, the jury eliminated projects that were well developed but generic, hermetic in their relationship with public space, insufficiently resolved in structural terms, financially demanding or unable to express the primary programme clearly.

A large proportion of the proposals offered a well-articulated but insufficiently specific response to the site and its legacy. A project that retained parts of the existing structure was considered particularly interesting, but this approach was not feasible because the structure had to be demolished due to identified structural deficiencies.

U anketnom dijelu modelirani park razvija se u dvije razine: središnja zelena os povezuje Maksimir i Borongaj, a uzdignuti krajolik prekriva dijelove programa, oblikuje trgove, rekreacijske zone i zelene krovove te povezuje stadion, bazen, atletiku i dvorane.
entries.descriptionEn: A sequence of massive white ribs wraps the stadium, giving rhythm to the façade and clearly expressing the building’s structural logic. Between the supports, open concourses, the seating structure and glazed public programmes remain visible, while the roof spreads radially toward the central opening. In the survey area, the modelled park develops across two levels: a central green axis links Maksimir and Borongaj, while an elevated landscape covers parts of the programme, forms plazas, recreation areas and planted roofs, and connects the stadium, swimming complex, athletics and sports halls.

entries.descriptionEn: The compact stadium is wrapped in a regular rhythm of timber vertical elements and a radially structured roof, giving the building a calm, tactile envelope. The seating bowl is organised as a layered operational system, while public forecourts and access surfaces continue directly into the park ground. In the survey area, sports facilities, infrastructure and open spaces are combined within a continuous landscape of trees, clearings, planted roofs and pedestrian routes connecting Maksimir with Borongaj.

Javni prsten šetnica obavija građevinu, povezuje ulaze i omogućuje svakodnevno korištenje krova neovisno o utakmicama, dok se otvoreno prizemlje pretvara u polunatkriveni gradski prostor. U anketnom dijelu stadioni, dvorane, garaža i terminal postaju zeleni humci povezani mrežom trgova, parkova i šetnica koja produžuje maksimirski krajolik prema Borongaju.
entries.descriptionEn: The stadium’s planted roof rises as a walkable hill, allowing the seating bowl to recede almost entirely within an artificially modelled topography. A public ring of paths wraps the building, connects its entrances and enables everyday use of the roof beyond matchdays, while the open ground floor becomes a semi-covered civic space. In the survey area, stadiums, halls, the garage and transit hub are formed as green mounds linked by a network of plazas, parks and promenades extending the Maksimir landscape toward Borongaj.

entries.descriptionHr: Dinamična ovojnica sastavljena od istaknutih metalnih kubusa obavija stadion poput trodimenzionalnog mozaika, stvarajući promjenjivu siluetu koja se mijenja ovisno o kutu gledanja i osvjetljenju. Iza razvedenog vanjskog sloja ostaju vidljivi ostakljeni javni sadržaji i unutarnji ophodi, dok noćna rasvjeta dodatno naglašava dubinu fasade. U anketnom dijelu stadion, dvorane, atletika i prometni sustavi povezuju se mrežom javnih trgova, zelenih površina i pješačkih pravaca između Maksimira i Borongaja.
entries.descriptionEn: A dynamic envelope of projecting metal cubes wraps the stadium like a three-dimensional mosaic, creating a shifting silhouette that changes with viewpoint and light. Behind this articulated outer layer, glazed public programmes and internal concourses remain visible, while night lighting further emphasises the depth of the façade. In the survey area, the stadium, sports halls, athletics facilities and transport systems are linked by a network of public plazas, planted spaces and pedestrian routes extending between Maksimir and Borongaj.
roundNoteHr: Za drugi krug ocjenjivački sud utvrdio je dodatne kriterije vrednovanja. Oni su obuhvaćali urbanistički koncept, kvalitetu i provedivost prijedloga, integraciju građevina i javnih prostora te organizacijske i oblikovne karakteristike pojedinih građevina, s posebnim naglaskom na prijedlog stadiona.

Generičke ili pretjerano ekspresivne konstrukcije, koje snažno određuju identitet stadiona, ali su zahtjevne u pogledu izvedbe ili troškova, ocijenjene su manje primjerenima zadanom programu i kontekstu. Slično se odnosilo na materijale zahtjevne za održavanje te pretjerano oslanjanje na vegetaciju unutar stadiona.
Važan kriterij eliminacije bila je i mogućnost fazne izgradnje, uz istodobno prepoznavanje arhitektonske kvalitete artikulacije programa.
roundNoteEn: For the second round, the jury established additional evaluation criteria. These included the urban concept, the quality and feasibility of the proposal, the integration of buildings and public spaces, and the organisational and formal qualities of the individual buildings, with particular emphasis on the stadium proposal.

Generic or overly expressive structures that strongly defined the stadium’s identity but presented significant challenges in terms of construction or cost were considered less appropriate to the programme and context. The same applied to high-maintenance materials and an excessive reliance on vegetation within the stadium.
The possibility of phased construction was also an important criterion for elimination, while the jury continued to recognise the architectural quality of the programme’s articulation.

entries.descriptionHr: Prozračna poluprozirna ovojnica obavija stadion i otkriva laganu drvenu prostornu konstrukciju, dajući građevini gotovo atmosfersku prisutnost između parka i grada. Otvoreni ophodi, neprekinuti vizualni odnos s travnjakom i kontinuirani ventilacijski pojas između krova i tribina stvaraju prirodno osvijetljen i prozračen prostor. U anketnom dijelu sportske dvorane oblikovane su kao zeleni brežuljci, dok mreža pješačkih putova, mostova i parkovnih čistina povezuje Maksimir, stadion, atletiku i Borongaj u jedinstven javni krajolik.
entries.descriptionEn: A permeable translucent envelope wraps the stadium, revealing a lightweight timber space frame and giving the building an almost atmospheric presence between park and city. Open concourses, uninterrupted visual connections to the pitch and a continuous ventilation gap between the roof and seating bowl create a naturally lit and ventilated interior. In the survey area, sports halls are conceived as green landforms, while a network of pedestrian routes, bridges and park clearings connects Maksimir, the stadium, athletics facilities and Borongaj into a unified public landscape.

entries.descriptionHr: Nisko položeni stadion uranja u park i postaje dio oblikovanog krajolika, dok otvoreni ophodi i široki vizualni koridori uspostavljaju neprekinutu vezu između tribinske zdjele i Maksimira. Monumentalna konstrukcija ostaje suzdržana, dopuštajući da park oblikuje identitet cijelog sklopa. U anketnom dijelu sportski sadržaji organizirani su kao niz paviljona u zelenilu, povezani središnjom pješačkom osi koja vodi od Maksimira prema Borongaju, kroz trgove, otvorene sportske terene, kišne vrtove i novi intermodalni prometni terminal.
entries.descriptionEn: The low-lying stadium is embedded within the park, becoming part of the modelled landscape, while open concourses and broad visual corridors establish a continuous relationship between the seating bowl and Maksimir Park. Its monumental structure remains deliberately restrained, allowing the landscape to define the identity of the entire complex. In the survey area, sports facilities are arranged as a sequence of pavilions within the greenery, linked by a central pedestrian spine extending from Maksimir to Borongaj through plazas, outdoor sports grounds, rain gardens and a new intermodal transport hub.

entries.descriptionHr: Koncept „Žive šume” pretvara cijeli kompleks u nastavak Maksimirskog parka, pri čemu krajolik postaje osnovna prostorna i arhitektonska struktura. Stadion se pojavljuje kao najveća krošnja urbanog ekosustava: otvorena rešetkasta ovojnica nosi vegetaciju, filtrira svjetlo i ublažava njegovu mjeru. Sportske građevine raspoređene su kao čistine unutar kontinuirane šume, povezane zelenom osi, vodenim krajolicima i mrežom pješačkih ruta prema Borongaju.
entries.descriptionEn: The “Living Forest” concept transforms the entire complex into an extension of Maksimir Park, with landscape becoming its primary spatial and architectural structure. The stadium appears as the largest canopy within an urban ecosystem: an open lattice envelope supports vegetation, filters light and reduces the perceived scale of the building. Sports facilities are arranged as clearings within a continuous forest, connected by a green spine, water landscapes and a network of pedestrian routes extending toward Borongaj.
roundNoteHr: U prvom krugu ocjenjivački sud pregledao je sve pristigle radove. Manje uspješnima ocijenjeni su i projekti bez dovoljno specifičnog identiteta, projekti s nedovoljno uvjerljivim odnosom prema gradu te prijedlozi pretjeranog mjerila ili zahtjevnog održavanja.

Projects without a sufficiently specific identity were also considered less successful, as were proposals with a less convincing relationship to the city and those characterised by excessive scale or demanding maintenance requirements.

In the survey area, sports halls, swimming pools, athletics facilities and the auxiliary stadium are connected by green roofs, pedestrian routes and public terraces designed for everyday use.

entries.descriptionHr: Natječajno rješenje uspostavlja jednostavnu i jasno čitljivu urbanističku organizaciju u kojoj su sportski sadržaji raspoređeni kao niz autonomnih volumena unutar prostranog parkovnog krajolika. Umjesto težnje formalnom spektaklu, kompozicija se oslanja na neposrednost, racionalnost i prostranost javnih prostora. Konept predviđa velike zelene površine između pojedinih sadržaja i omogućuje da se kompleks doživljava kao otvoreni sportski park, a ne kao skup zatvorenih građevina. U anketnoj zoni topografija, postojeće drveće i novi zeleni koridori povezuju sportske sadržaje, javne trgove, Borongaj i Maksimir u kontinuirani sportski krajolik.
entries.descriptionEn: The proposal establishes a simple and clearly legible urban organisation in which the sports facilities are distributed as a series of autonomous geometric pavilions within an expansive park landscape. Rather than pursuing formal spectacle, the composition relies on directness, rationality and the generosity of everyday public spaces. The arrangement leaves extensive green areas between the individual facilities and allows the complex to be experienced as an open sports park rather than a collection of enclosed buildings. In the survey area, topography, existing trees and new green corridors connect sports facilities, public plazas, Borongaj and Maksimir into a continuous sporting landscape.
juryHr: Kompaktan pravokutni volumen obavijen je laganom metalnom ovojnicom koja filtrira dnevno svjetlo, prikriva složen unutarnji program i stadionu daje miran i jedinstven identitet. Transparentno prizemlje, četiri ravnopravno dostupna ulaza i niz međuprostora rastvaraju granicu između grada, stadiona i parka Maksimir, dok je gledalište djelomično ukopano u teren kako bi se smanjio njezin vizualni utjecaj.

Stadion je zamišljen kao kompaktna i introvertirana arena snažne unutarnje atmosfere. Gledalište i kontinuirani krov tvore racionalnu cjelinu utilitarnog karaktera, a neprekinuta krovna ploha koncentrira doživljaj gledatelja i intenzivira sportski događaj. Vanjski sustav stubišta obavija stadion i postaje njegov glavni arhitektonski motiv, dok tanka metalna ovojnica objedinjuje različite komunikacijske, konstruktivne i programske slojeve u apstraktan volumen. Propusno interaktivno pročelje istodobno filtrira svjetlo i djelomično otkriva kretanje iza ovojnice, stvarajući promjenjivu sliku građevine.

Projekt pokazuje visok stupanj funkcionalne racionalnosti i jasno razdvaja tokove publike, sportaša i tehničkih sadržaja. Njegova geometrijska jednostavnost podupire razumljivu organizaciju, ekonomičnu konstruktivnu logiku i prilagodljivost budućim načinima korištenja. Krajobraz nije tretiran kao dekorativna pozadina, nego kao vezivno tkivo koje povezuje autonomne volumene i prostoru daje karakter svakodnevno dostupnog javnog kompleksa.

Vrijednost prijedloga leži u njegovoj mirnoj, racionalnoj i dosljednoj arhitekturi, snažnoj atmosferi unutarnje arene te jasnom odnosu jednostavnih volumena i prostranih parkovnih površina. Istodobno, introvertirani karakter stadiona i njegova apstraktna metalna ovojnica umanjuju neposrednu vezu između unutarnjeg života građevine i okolnog javnog prostora.
juryEn: A compact rectangular volume is wrapped in a lightweight metal lattice that filters daylight, conceals the complex internal programme and gives the stadium a calm, unified identity. A transparent ground floor, four equally accessible entrances and a sequence of intermediate spaces dissolve the boundary between the city, the stadium and Maksimir Park, while the seating bowl is partially embedded into the terrain to reduce its visual impact. The stadium is conceived as a compact and introverted arena with a strong internal atmosphere. The seating bowl and continuous roof form a rational and convincing whole, while the uninterrupted roof surface further concentrates the spectator experience and intensifies the sporting event. An external system of staircases wraps the stadium and becomes its principal architectural motif, while a thin metal veil unifies the different circulation, structural and programmatic layers into an abstract volume. The responsive facade simultaneously filters light and partially reveals movement behind the envelope, producing a changing image of the building.

The project demonstrates a high degree of functional rationality and clearly separates public, sport and technical flows. Its geometric simplicity supports an understandable organisation, an economical structural logic and adaptability to future modes of use. The landscape is not treated as a decorative background, but as the connective tissue that links the autonomous pavilions and gives the site the character of an everyday public complex.

The value of the proposal lies in its calm, rational and consistent architecture, the strong atmosphere of the internal arena, and the clear relationship between simple pavilions and expansive park spaces. At the same time, the introverted character of the stadium and its abstract metal envelope reduce the immediate relationship between the building's internal life and the surrounding public realm.

entries.descriptionHr: Otvorena konstrukcija stadiona odbacuje klasičnu fasadnu ovojnicu i izlaže nosivi sustav poput suvremene katedrale, dok zaobljeni krovni volumen lebdi iznad tribinske zdjele i pratećih sadržaja. Vanjski armiranobetonski okvir organizira ophode, javne prostore i servisne programe, a stadion ostaje djelomično vidljiv kao zaseban objekt unutar konstrukcijske matrice. U anketnom dijelu središnja promenada povezuje Maksimir, sportske dvorane, atletiku i Borongaj, dok niz trgova, zelenih koridora i odvojenih prometnih tokova strukturira cijeli kompleks.
entries.descriptionEn: The stadium rejects a conventional façade and exposes its supporting structure like a contemporary cathedral, while a rounded roof volume appears to float above the seating bowl and supporting programmes. An external reinforced-concrete frame organises concourses, public spaces and service functions, leaving the arena partially visible as a distinct object within the structural grid. In the survey area, a central promenade links Maksimir Park, the sports halls, athletics facilities and Borongaj, while a sequence of plazas, green corridors and separated traffic flows structures the entire complex.
roundNoteHr: U trećem krugu eliminirani su dobro razrađeni, ali generički projekti, prijedlozi hermetičnog odnosa prema javnom prostoru, projekti s nedovoljno razrađenim konstrukcijskim sustavom te financijski zahtjevna rješenja ili rješenja koja nisu dovoljno jasno izražavala primarni program.

Velik broj radova ponudio je dobro artikuliran, ali nedovoljno specifičan odnos prema lokaciji i njezinu nasljeđu. Posebno je zanimljiv bio projekt koji je zadržavao dijelove postojeće konstrukcije, no takav pristup nije bio izvediv zbog potrebe za njezinim uklanjanjem uslijed utvrđenih konstrukcijskih nedostataka.
roundNoteEn: In the third round, the jury eliminated projects that were well developed but generic, hermetic in their relationship with public space, insufficiently resolved in structural terms, financially demanding or unable to express the primary programme clearly.

A large proportion of the proposals offered a well-articulated but insufficiently specific response to the site and its legacy. A project that retained parts of the existing structure was considered particularly interesting, but this approach was not feasible because the structure had to be demolished due to identified structural deficiencies.

entries.descriptionHr: Zrcalno obložena tribinska zdjela lebdi iznad slojevitih javnih ophoda i u svojoj poliranoj površini reflektira park, nebo i tokove navijača, pretvarajući stadion u promjenjivu sliku vlastitog okruženja. Sustav plavih rampi razvija se poput razgranate mreže koja vodi prema povišenim panoramskim ophodima, odvaja tokove publike i ostaje javno dostupan izvan dana utakmica. U anketnom dijelu velika sjeverno-južna esplanada povezuje Maksimir i Borongaj te organizira dvorane, atletiku, pomoćni stadion i sportske terene kao jedinstven javni potez.
entries.descriptionEn: A mirror-clad seating bowl floats above layered public concourses, reflecting the park, sky and streams of supporters in its polished surface and turning the stadium into a shifting image of its surroundings. A system of blue ramps unfolds as a branching network leading to elevated panoramic walkways, separating crowd flows while remaining publicly accessible beyond matchdays. In the survey area, a broad north–south esplanade links Maksimir Park with Borongaj and organises the halls, athletics facilities, auxiliary stadium and training grounds as one continuous civic sequence.
roundNoteHr: U četvrtom krugu eliminirani su visoko ocijenjeni projekti koji nisu dovoljno uvjerljivo programski povezivali kompleks s neposrednim okruženjem ili nisu ostvarili dovoljno snažan kontekstualni odnos.
Ocjenjivački sud ipak je prepoznao ambicioznost pristupa i uvjerljivu razinu razrade pojedinih projekata.
roundNoteEn: In the fourth round, the jury eliminated highly rated projects that did not establish a sufficiently convincing programmatic relationship with their immediate surroundings or a sufficiently strong contextual response.
Nevertheless, the jury recognised the ambition of the approach and the convincing level of development demonstrated by several proposals.

entries.descriptionHr: Translucentna mrežasta kupola lebdi iznad ukopane tribinske zdjele i velikog natkrivenog javnog trga, stvarajući stadion kao hibrid između arene, infrastrukture i gradske prostorije. Tehnički sadržaji povučeni su ispod javnog partera, dok povišeni programski plato s muzejom, hotelom, trgovinama i ugostiteljstvom formira drugi urbani sloj iznad njega. U anketnom dijelu kvadratni prostorni okvir povezuje dvorane, atletiku, sportske terene, šumu i trgove u jedinstven „building-masterplan” sposoban za faznu izgradnju i buduće promjene
entries.descriptionEn: A translucent mesh dome floats above a sunken seating bowl and a vast covered civic plaza, shaping the stadium as a hybrid between arena, infrastructure and urban room. Technical programmes are concealed below the public ground, while an elevated platform containing the museum, hotel, retail and hospitality forms a second urban layer above it. In the survey area, a square spatial frame connects halls, athletics, sports fields, forest and plazas within a single “building-masterplan” conceived to accommodate phased construction and future transformation.
roundNoteHr: Za drugi krug ocjenjivački sud utvrdio je dodatne kriterije vrednovanja. Oni su obuhvaćali urbanistički koncept, kvalitetu i provedivost prijedloga, integraciju građevina i javnih prostora te organizacijske i oblikovne karakteristike pojedinih građevina, s posebnim naglaskom na prijedlog stadiona.

Generičke ili pretjerano ekspresivne konstrukcije, koje snažno određuju identitet stadiona, ali su zahtjevne u pogledu izvedbe ili troškova, ocijenjene su manje primjerenima zadanom programu i kontekstu. Slično se odnosilo na materijale zahtjevne za održavanje te pretjerano oslanjanje na vegetaciju unutar stadiona.
Važan kriterij eliminacije bila je i mogućnost fazne izgradnje, uz istodobno prepoznavanje arhitektonske kvalitete artikulacije programa.
roundNoteEn: For the second round, the jury established additional evaluation criteria. These included the urban concept, the quality and feasibility of the proposal, the integration of buildings and public spaces, and the organisational and formal qualities of the individual buildings, with particular emphasis on the stadium proposal.

Generic or overly expressive structures that strongly defined the stadium’s identity but presented significant challenges in terms of construction or cost were considered less appropriate to the programme and context. The same applied to high-maintenance materials and an excessive reliance on vegetation within the stadium.
The possibility of phased construction was also an important criterion for elimination, while the jury continued to recognise the architectural quality of the programme’s articulation.

A continuous canopy and pedestrian ring connect the entire perimeter, while the structural grid allows future capacity expansion and the gradual addition of new programmes. In the survey area, the sports buildings follow an orthogonal matrix, while the compact hall complex creates a spatial balance at the opposite edge of the site.
